**Required Skills** 




  




* Java and Spring framework expertise
* CI/CD and build pipelines knowledge
* Basic understanding of React JS, Javascript and/or Typescript
* Familiarity with Git, Gradle, Maven, and RPM
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
* Agile environment experience
* Problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail
* Team collaboration skills
* Bug identification and validation skills



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience with micro-frontends
* Comfort with AI-assisted development tools



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 We believe talent knows no boundaries. Our hiring process focuses solely on your skills, experience, and potential to contribute to our team.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate each candidate based on merit, regardless of personal characteristics as the age, gender, origin, religion, sexual orientation, neurodiversity or disability.

title: Fullstackutvecklare sökes till Data & Analytics-teamet på Martin & Servera
description:
*Vi på Martin & Servera levererar mat och dryck till restauranger, kaféer och storkök över hela Sverige. Här är du med och driver utvecklingen i en tid då digitalisering och ny teknik öppnar upp nya dörrar för oss, våra kunder och hela restaurangbranschen. Genom teknik i framkant, nya arbetssätt och en hög förändringstakt är du med och gör varje dag lite godare. Du blir också en del av en varm och inkluderande kultur där vi jobbar tillsammans och har roligt ihop.*
**Teknik i framkant**
 Martin & Servera är inne i en spännande digitaliseringsresa. Vår digitala transformation har stor strategisk bäring och vi satsar mycket på att erbjuda vår anställda de bästa verktygen för att optimera arbetssätt och affärsbeslut.
   

  

 Vill du driva utvecklingen av affärskritiska applikationer som optimerar prissättning och affärsbeslut? Vi söker nu en
 **Fullstackutvecklare** 
 som vill ta arbeta med att vidareutveckla och förvalta våra system för prissättning av artiklar, offerter och kampanjer.
   

  

**Fullstackutvecklare**
 Vi önskar komplettera vårt team med en Fullstackutvecklare som hunnit arbeta några år och hunnit skaffa sig goda kunskaper inom applikationsutveckling och har ett stort intresse för arkitektur och teknik.
   

  

 I rollen som Fullstackutvecklare kommer du att förvalta och utveckla applikationer som är centrala i Martin & Servera-gruppens verksamhet. Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med prisstrateger, analytiker och andra för att tillsammans med ett externt utvecklingsteam säkerställa marknadens bästa verktyg för prissättning.
   

  

 Rollen innebär både nyutveckling och kontinuerligt underhåll av våra affärskritiska system. Du säkerställer att de är stabila, presterar väl och vidareutvecklas utifrån verksamhetens behov.
   

  

**Viktigt för att jobbet ska passa dig.**
 För att du ska passa för rollen som Fullstackutvecklare har du troligtvis arbetat några år i en liknande roll där du har skaffat dig erfarenhet av att omvandla önskemål till användbar kod och är van vid att arbeta självständigt. Som person är du självgående, och du trivs i en miljö där du ges stor frihet i ditt arbete. Du kommer gärna med förslag på bättre lösningar samt är orädd inför att utmana status quo när det behövs.
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som**
* har flerårig högskoleutbildning inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller annan likvärdig utbildning.
* har minst 5 års erfarenhet inom systemutveckling.
* har goda kunskaper inom programmeringsspråken PHP, Python samt C#.
* har goda kunskaper inom Docker, MySql/MariaDB, .Net, Javascript, Html/Css, Git
* är flytande i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.
* är flexibel och har förmåga att arbeta i en föränderlig miljö med externa konsulter, anställda, IT och verksamhet på olika nivåer i organisationen.
* har praktisk erfarenhet av molnplattformar som GCP, AWS och Azure


**Det Är Även Meriterande Om Du Har Erfarenhet**
* av NoSQL, Azure. R, Linux, Frontend ramverk så som nodeJS, VueJS eller Svelte.
* inom objektorienterad programmering.
* inom agil utveckling och agila arbetssätt.


**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!** 
 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Skicka därför in din ansökan redan idag!
   

  

**Sista ansökningsdag** 
 är 27 september 2026.
   

  

**Tillträde:** 
 Enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

**Anställningsform** 
 : Tillsvidareanställning heltid, vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning.
   

  

**Bolag** 
 : Martin & Servera AB, Lindhagensgatan 133 Kungsholmen.
   

  

**Kontakt** 
 : För frågor om rollen kontakta: Annika Garneij Glans, annika.garneijglans@martinservera.se
   

  

**Facklig företrädare:** 
 Anna-Lena Holsteryd, al.holsteryd@martinservera.se
   

  

**Välkommen till Martin & Servera**
 Tillsammans gör vi på Martin & Servera-gruppen skillnad för alla som älskar mat och dryck. Med omtanke om varandra, våra kunder och allas framtid gör vi varje dag lite godare. Och som medarbetare hos oss är du en viktig del av framgången. På Martin & Servera växer vi och utvecklas tillsammans samtidigt som alla är viktiga och får ta plats. Vi är en familjeägd koncern med över 3000 medarbetare. Här tas dina erfarenheter, idéer och kunskaper tillvara. Välkommen till oss.
   

  

**Var med och gör skillnad**
 Vi är en platt organisation där teamen jobbar självständigt och har mandat att fatta beslut. Som medarbetare hos oss är du med och påverkar och driver restaurangbranschen framåt, varje dag.
   

  

**Trygghet och möjligheter**
 Vi har en stark och långsiktig ägare i form av Axel Johnson, vilket skapar trygghet och stora möjligheter. Eftersom vi tycker det är viktigt att arbetslivet går ihop med vardagen finns det möjligheter till både hemarbete som flexibla arbetstider.
   

  

**Hur går rekryteringen till?**
 Vi arbetar aktivt för mångfald och ser olikheter som en styrka. Därför välkomnar vi sökande i alla åldrar och med olika bakgrunder. I våra rekryteringar använder vi oss av personlighetstest. Det är för att kunna jämföra kandidater på ett så rättvist sätt som möjligt. Vi gör också bakgrundskontroller. Läs mer om rekryteringen här.
   

  

 En trygg och säker arbetsmiljö är grundläggande för oss. Därför följer vi upp vår alkohol- och drogpolicy genom test under den inledande anställningsperioden och därefter genom slumpmässiga tester på alla våra arbetsplatser.

title: Backend Developer
description:
*If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?*
**We are now looking for a Backend Developer**
 As a Backend Developer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and optimization of our backend systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of developers and engineers, focusing on technologies such as C#, Microsoft Orleans, ASP.NET Core, Azure, and SQL Server. If you are passionate about building scalable and efficient backend solutions, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* Proven experience in backend development using C# and ASP.NET Core.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Orleans or other actor model frameworks for distributed and scalable systems.
* Strong expertise in designing and optimizing database structures, preferably with SQL Server.
* Experience with cloud technologies, particularly Azure.
* Understanding of different backend architectural styles and best practices.
* Not required but beneficial if you have experience with Kubernetes and frontend development


**What you'll do:**
* Application Development: Design and develop backend solutions using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft Orleans, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Cloud Integration: Utilize Azure services to build and optimize cloud-based backend components, ensuring seamless integration with our applications.
* Database Management: Design and implement efficient database structures using SQL Server, optimizing data storage, and retrieval for optimal system performance.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the successful delivery of projects.
* Third-party platforms: Build, monitor and maintain integrations with third party platforms.


**Our tech stack**
* NET/C#, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Azure, SQL Server, CosmosDB, Redis, Grafana, Angular, TypeScript


****How to apply****
 If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.
   

  

 We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.
   

  

**Practical Information**
**Scope:** 
 Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Office first, hybrid solution possible. You need to be eligible to work in Sweden.
   

  

**We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find dogs and occasionally some cats around.**
**What We Offer**
 Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 100+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.
   

  

 Located in a newly built, custom-tailored offices on the Hammarby Kaj waterfront, we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. A thriving game dev scene, along with all types of activities are immediately available on our doorstep.
   

  

 Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.
   

  

 We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Senior Java Developer

 Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid)

 We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to join a highly skilled engineering team building secure, business-critical digital services used by organisations across Sweden. title: Sr. Fullstack Engineer – Backend | Ads Orchestration
description:
At TV4, technology, innovation, journalism, sports and entertainment come together.
   

  

 Every week, around eight million people use TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo. Advertising is a fundamental part of what makes both our streaming services and the content we produce possible.
   

  

 We are now looking for a
 **Senior Fullstack Engineer** 
 to join Ads Orchestration, the team building the product capabilities that enable us to sell, deliver, measure and evolve the future of our advertising business.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 We are currently modernising our entire advertising platform.
   

  

 From how campaigns are sold and booked to how they are planned, delivered, optimised, measured and followed up.
   

  

 At the same time, we are consolidating the systems behind TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo into a shared Nordic platform.
   

  

 This is not just a technology transformation.
   

  

 It is about creating the capabilities we need to develop new advertising products faster, respond to changing market needs and give the business greater freedom to evolve.
   

  

 We are replacing external dependencies with services we build and own ourselves, creating a platform that can evolve with the business for years to come.
   

  

**Why you might want to join**
 You want to work in a team that owns more than code.
   

  

 Here, you will work closely with product, users and the business to understand which problems are worth solving and how we know that our solutions are creating real impact.
   

  

 You enjoy working in a team that takes responsibility for the entire journey, from idea and prioritisation to implementation, launch, measurement and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You are comfortable with complex flows, integrations and business-critical processes. More importantly, you enjoy making that complexity understandable, useful and valuable.
   

  

 You are motivated by building new capabilities in an environment where technology, product and business work closely together.
   

  

 You see AI as a natural part of modern software development and are curious about how new tools and ways of working can help teams learn faster, build smarter and create more value.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Ads Orchestration is building the capabilities needed for an efficient and future-proof advertising business.
   

  

 The team connects the needs of users, customers and partners with digital workflows that create measurable business value.
   

  

 We operate where technology, product and advertising meet, with the goal of reducing friction, increasing transparency and helping TV4 develop advertising products faster and more effectively.
   

  

 As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will join a cross-functional team with a strong product focus and close collaboration with stakeholders, users and business partners.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build and evolve scalable services in a cloud-native, modular architecture
* Develop across the stack, working with both backend services and user-facing applications
* Design APIs and integrations connecting products, platforms and business processes
* Contribute to architectural decisions and technical direction
* Use AI tools actively as part of the development process
* Take responsibility for observability, monitoring and continuous improvement
* Work closely with product, users and stakeholders to turn real needs into working solutions
* Help shape the next generation of TV4's advertising platform


**About You**
 You are an experienced fullstack engineer who is comfortable working across both frontend and backend.

description:

**THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL
   

  

 You?** 
 A curious, hands-on iOS developer who loves a real challenge. You aren't looking to just tweak edge cases, you want to take ownership of a product, overhaul a demanding user experience, and turn it into something excellent.
   

  

**Role?** 
 You’ll take ownership of native iOS experiences across our vehicle transaction flows.  Swift, UIKit, SwiftUI, SPM, Combine
   

  

**Company?** 
 Vend, home to Northern Europe's most iconic marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen. Millions of people connect on our platforms every day to make life-changing decisions: buying a home, finding a job, or purchasing their next car.
   

  

**Location?** 
 Join us in either our Oslo or Stockholm office with the flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week: your choice, your balance.
   

  

**Why us?**
 Buying or selling a car can be confusing and complicated. We’re changing that by offering a simple, step-by-step transaction flow for private sales across FINN, Blocket, and Vend’s Nordic marketplaces.
   

  

 Our team consists of 8 skilled individuals who work agile and dynamically towards concrete goals. We collaborate closely with an extended product team. As a valued member of our team, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact, contribute with your unique expertise, and grow both personally and professionally.
   

  

**Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!**
**WHO ARE YOU?**
* Experienced iOS developer with at least 3 years of hands-on experience
* Fluent in English. Clear communication is key in our international, cross-functional team.
* Proactive and responsible, someone who steps up when needed and takes ownership of their work.
* Team player who loves to collaborate, share knowledge, and learn from others.
* Quality-focused, taking pride in writing clean code and testing thoroughly to ensure smooth user experiences.

title: Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform
description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.About COMSOLCOMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.RoleBased in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.QualificationsFor this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:
   

  

* M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
* Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
* Several years of professional software development experience.
* An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.


 Experience with the following will be highly valued:
   

  

* Large software projects and mature codebases.
* Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
* Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
* Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
* Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
* Build and development automation.
* Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.


 No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.Working at COMSOLAt COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.We also offer:
   

  

* A competitive salary
* Individual pension plans
* Sponsored gym membership
* Work-life balance with regular working hours


 To ensure a smooth onboarding process, onsite presence is required. Once onboarded, hybrid work options are available.To ApplyDoes this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish using the form below. Make sure to include:
   

  

* Cover letter
* CV
* University diploma with grades


 Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.For more information, contact Mikael Sterner at tel. 08-412 95 00.We review applications continuously.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer - Grafana Ops - IRM | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**This is a full time remote role for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.**
**The Opportunity**
 The Grafana IRM squad operates a business critical set of services that help Grafana and multiple organizations across the globe respond to incidents. Our mission is “We make it easy to detect, respond, and learn from incidents with minimal toil”. We have three functional squads within our team, frontend, backend and mobile, but our work is usually spread across the three functions.
   

  

 Our domain is quite large and it is constantly evolving. Our key values are
 *unified experience* 
 ,
 *automation and integration* 
 and
 *Observability Native.* 
 We are customer focused and aim to provide an excellent customer experience for efficient usage with a high degree of automation and integration to multiple 3rd party systems that our users can leverage. When we say
 *Observability Native* 
 is in our core, we really mean it, we want to highlight the integration of IRM with observability, which enables teams to gain actionable insights and resolve incidents more efficiently. The value is faster and more informed decision making.
   

  

 Grafana IRM is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives.
* Work with your team to deliver new features, then use the results to iterate and improve.
* Drive projects from initial ideation all the way to operations once it is in the hands of customers.
* Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope.
* Design, build, operate, and maintain Grafana’s mobile Application, owning the reliability, performance, and availability.
* Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the application you’re running.
* Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions and collaborate with the team.
* Learn new skills by gaining a deeper understanding of our cloud product and our customers and getting to know the codebase of a large distributed system.


 As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.
   

  

 What are we looking for in you?
   

  

* You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action.
* You are customer focused.
* We build everything with our users in mind.
* You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.
* Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively.
* Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must.


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* Experience with at least one native mobile platform (Android or iOS).
* Strong experience building production Flutter apps, including state management, navigation, asynchronous programming, and architecting maintainable codebases.
* Experience taking mobile features from idea to release in a self-driven way, from clarifying requirements and exploring solutions to building, testing, CI/CD workflows, and shipping updates to the App Store and Google Play
* Comfort integrating mobile apps with backend APIs and cloud services
* Write clean, maintainable, and performant code that is easy for other engineers to understand and extend.


**Bonus Points For**
* Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects).
* Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, or a desire to learn.
* Familiarity with being on-call and performing operations/SRE tasks or with the concept of infrastructure as code.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source projects


**Compensation & Rewards**
 In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 878,000 - 1,098,500. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*

 As a Software Engineer (Data) you will assist and maintain the data initiatives at the company, by providing validated data and the infrastructure to calculate key performance indicators to different stakeholders while still safeguarding our users' privacy and anonymity into your work.
 



  





**Please note that we are hiring for this role in Stockholm, Sweden.** 




  





**What you will be doing** 




  




* Maintain and improve our data warehouse: improve data models, performance of views and reports, etc.
* Maintain and improve our data pipelines: integrate new sources, improve monitoring and performance, etc.
* Investigate and report data quality issues and data inconsistencies
* Collaborate with stakeholders and other departments by providing dashboards and reports
* Collaborate with data scientists by providing adequate raw data for their needs
* Automate routine operations related to data
* Assist the Senior Data Engineer with incoming requests for change



  





**What skills and experience we think you have** 




  





**General** 



* Some understanding of data infrastructure and deployment pipelines
* Good knowledge of analyst tools to allow data visualization (we use Tableau and Mixpanel)
* Great analytical skills to conduct root cause analysis and similar investigations
* Collaborate with R&D teams as well as stakeholders from other teams, such as medical product and regulatory



**Data** 



* Knowledge of ETL and data pipelines (written in Python and Typescript)
* Interest in Business Intelligence reporting tools (we currently use Tableau)
* SQL (data definition, data manipulation, analytical functions)
* Python



**Backend** 



* RESTful API
* Typescript (or strong bases in another software development language)



  





**What we offer** 




  




* Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location
* Professional development - you will work alongside knowledgeable colleagues in the continuous growth and skill enhancement environment
* Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work
* Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value
* Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development



  





**Location** 




 We are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person. For this role, you’ll collaborate closely with our Senior Data Engineer, who is based in Stockholm.
 



  





**Sounds interesting?** 




 If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.
 



  





 We look forward to hearing from you!
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.
 



  





 At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.
 



  





  





**Note: We are not looking for consultants or help from recruitment agencies**

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 You care about building products that people actually use, not just apps that look good in a demo. In previous roles, you were likely the person who took a feature from idea to the App Store and made sure it kept working once real users got their hands on it.
   

  

 At Tandem, you'll own our mobile apps and shape where they go next. Our apps are newly launched and currently built around a web view, and we expect to move towards native over time. You'll play a key role in that journey: deciding what to build natively, when, and how, together with the team.
   

  

 Mobile will be your home base, but this is not a siloed role. You'll be a fullstack engineer at heart and will also help out across other products and parts of our platform, wherever your skills make the biggest difference.
   

  

 You move fast, but not carelessly. You work in a healthcare context where reliability, security and trust matter, and you know how to balance shipping quickly with building things that hold up. You care about the end user, whether that's a clinician between patients or a patient on the other side.
   

  

 This is a high-impact role where you'll not only ship features, but shape how we build and scale mobile at Tandem.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
* Own and develop our mobile apps (iOS and Android) end-to-end, from design and implementation to release and maintenance.
* Build and improve the bridge between our web experience and native device capabilities.
* Own App Store and Google Play submissions, review and compliance processes, and release tooling.
* Diagnose and fix native-specific bugs and performance issues, from cold start to crash handling.
* Work across the stack on other products and platform features alongside the rest of the engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with product, design and clinicians to turn real-world needs into great user experiences.
* Help set the standard for how we build, test and ship mobile at Tandem.


****What You Bring****
* Strong experience building and shipping mobile apps in production, preferably in a fast-moving SaaS environment.
* Hands-on experience with native development on iOS and/or Android (Swift, Kotlin or similar).
* Experience shipping and maintaining apps through the App Store and Google Play, including review and compliance cycles.
* Experience working with web views and the connection between web and native.
* A product mindset - you think in user outcomes, not just tickets and APIs.
* Strong ownership: you've worked in high-pace environments where you wore multiple hats.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative, low-ego way of working.


**Bonus Points**
* Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments
* Experience with push notifications, authentication flows or other native device integrations
* Experience with a gradual migration from web to native
* Familiarity with CI/CD and release tooling for mobile (e.g. Fastlane, TestFlight)
* Interest in AI products, especially in a healthcare context
* Experience building audio-related or real-time features on mobile


****Location****
 We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our vibrant HQ in the Epicenter building in the heart of Stockholm where you will work primarily from our office to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
   

  

****How to Apply****
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Our interview process consists of 5 stages:
   

  

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* Technical interviews with some of our Engineering team
* Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads
* Home or live case and presentation at our office - Join us in the Stockholm office for a lunch and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how we work in action.


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.


*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*
**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Androidutvecklare med ansvar för kvalitet och test
description:
Vill du ta en ledande roll i att bygga upp testinfrastruktur inom Android till nästa generations kommunikationssystem?
   

  

**Organisation** 
 It-avdelningen
 **Kommun** 
 Stockholm
 **Län** 
 Stockholms län
 **Utlyst** 
 6 oktober 2026
 **Ansök senast** 
 27 oktober 2026
 **Referensnummer**
 Arbetsplatsbeskrivning
   

  

 Polisen står nu inför ett av sina största teknikskiften på många år när det gäller kommunikation, där vi går från Rakel till Rakel generation 2. Detta kommer att ge helt nya möjligheter för mobil kommunikation, datadelning och verksamhetskritiska tjänster för tusentals användare över hela Sverige. Som en del av det här arbetet behöver applikationer i den nya mobila miljön utvecklas. Vi söker nu en Androidutvecklare med intresse för test som vill ta en ledande roll i att ta fram testautomatisering och utveckla mobil appinfrastruktur med fokus på Android. Du kommer att arbeta inom sektionen Mobil systemutveckling på IT-avdelningen, sektionen består idag av tre grupper som har helhetsansvar för att designa, bygga och förvalta mobilappar, samt anknytande backendtjänster och applikationer.
   

  

 Du kommer att ha din placering i moderna lokaler centralt på Kungsholmen i Stockholm, och det finns möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till två dagar i veckan. Som statligt anställd på Polismyndigheten erbjuds du särskilda förmåner kring pension, föräldralön, friskvård m.m. Läs mer om våra förmåner och villkor här: https://polisen.se/jobb-och-utbildning/jobba-hos-polisen/jobb-it-avdelningen/vara-formaner/
   

  

 Arbetsbeskrivning
   

  

 Vi söker en Androidutvecklare som vill ta en ledande roll i att forma framtidens mobila plattformar inom Polisen. Hos oss får du inte enbart utveckla appar, du får vara med och bygga den tekniska grund som framtida mobila lösningar kommer att stå på. Du kommer att påverka arkitektur, teststrategi, automatisering och utvecklingsprocesser i en miljö där kvalitet, säkerhet och robusthet är avgörande.
   

  

 Du kommer inte in i ett färdigt testlandskap. Du kommer vara med och definiera hur kvalitetssäkring ska fungera för Polismyndighetens Androidplattform. För att förstå användarnas behov arbetar vi nära verksamheten. Du kommer bland annat få möjlighet att följa poliser i deras vardag och omsätta verkliga behov till tekniska lösningar. Det ger en direkt koppling mellan din kod och den samhällsnytta den skapar. Om du drivs av tekniska utmaningar, vill arbeta med moderna Android-lösningar och brinner för att bygga kvalitet från grunden kan detta vara en av de mest spännande Androidrollerna i Sverige just nu.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Kontinuerligt designa och vidareutveckla automatiserade tester för Android.
* Sätta tekniska riktlinjer för kvalitet och testbarhet.
* Bidra till arkitekturval som möjliggör robust och effektiv testning.
* Tillsammans med andra utvecklare regelbundet säkerhetsställa kvaliteten i utvecklingsprocessen.
* Utveckla CI/CD-flöden som ger snabba och säkra leveranser.
* Hjälpa teamet att hitta rätt balans mellan unit-, integration-, UI- och end-to-end-tester.


 Vill du veta mer om vår grupp och arbetet, läs gärna mer via följande länk där Samuel berättar som sin arbetsvardag: https://polisen.se/jobb-och-utbildning/jobba-hos-polisen/jobb-it-avdelningen/sagt-om-jobbet/samuel-systemutvecklare/
   

  

 Kvalifikationer
   

  

**Detta är en möjlighet för dig som har:**
* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, exempelvis inom webb/systemutveckling, inbyggda system eller liknande. Alternativt att du har motsvarande förvärvad kompetens som Polismyndigheten bedömer likvärdig
* Flerårig aktuell och relevant yrkeserfarenhet av Android-utveckling, företrädesvis från en stor organisation
* Flerårig aktuell och relevant yrkeserfarenhet av test inom Android
* Goda kunskaper om Android OS
* Du behöver behärska svenska mycket väl i tal och skrift och engelska väl i tal och skrift
* Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap


**Meriterande:**
 Nedanstående kompetenser/teknikområden är i övrigt meriterande, du behöver inte ha kompetens kring allt, då du kommer att få möjlighet att lära dig/få påbyggnad hos oss på plats:
   

  

* God kompetens kring att ta fram lösningsarkitektur
* Erfarenhet av att designa hållbara arkitekturer för testautomatisering
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av byggautomation samt av att sätta upp CI/CD-flöden för Androidutveckling
* Utveckling med hårda krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och av prestandakritiska IT-system
* Erfarenhet av hårdvarunära utveckling knutet till Android-enheter
* Erfarenhet av olika Androidspecifika testramverk som: JUnit, UI Automator, Android-emulatorer och/eller fysiska testenheter.
* Erfarenhet av testrapportering och synlighet, spårbarhet (observability)


**Personliga egenskaper**
 Vi ser att du är skicklig på att analysera och lösa komplexa tekniska problem med en ambition att driva effektiv utveckling som löser användarnas problem och stärker deras förmåga. Du bidrar till att skapa en kultur av samarbete och kunskapsdelning, där vi strävar efter att ständigt förbättra våra processer och tekniska lösningar. Nyfikenhet och omvärldsbevakning ser vi som en viktig del för att trivas hos oss.
   

  

 På samma gång vill vi erbjuda dig en plats att utvecklas, både i din tekniska kompetens och som en lagspelare. Vi tror starkt på kunskapsdelning och gemensam iteration för att ständigt ligga i teknisk framkant – samtidigt som vi har det roligt tillsammans.
   

  

 Vi värdesätter dina personliga egenskaper högt och kommer lägga mycket stor vikt vid dessa för att hitta rätt person för rollen.
   

  

 Kontaktpersoner
   

  

 Har du frågor om uppdraget är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef på tel 0105634758
   

  

 Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen? Välkommen att kontakta HR-konsult, Sara Petersson, sara-s.petersson@polisen.se
   

  

 Fackliga företrädare
   

  

 Polisförbundet, Sofia Ask, tfn 010-563 87 10
   

  

 Seko Polisen, Karna Tillheden, tfn 073-249 04 22
   

  

 Saco-S, nås via mejl saco-s.avdelningarna@polisen.se
   

  

 ST nås via mejl, st.inom-polisen@polisen.se
   

  

 Övrig information
   

  

 Anställningsform: Tillsvidare
   

  

 Arbetsort: Stockholm/Kungsholmen
   

  

 Arbetstid: Förtroendearbetstid
   

  

 Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

 Anställningsbenämning: Handläggare
   

  

 Funktion: Systemutvecklare
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Ansök genom att bifoga ditt CV (vi vill inte ha något personligt brev) och besvara urvalsfrågorna. Frågorna utgår från kravprofilen för den här rekryteringen och dina svar ligger till grund för det urval som sker i processen.
 **Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.**
 Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och besvarande av urvalsfrågorna via e-post till jobb.na@polisen.se senast 27/10 2026. Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via den mailadress som anges i annonsen. Märk din ansökan med referensnummer
 **A570.651/2026** 
 i mailets ärendemening.
   

  

**Besvara följande urvalsfrågor som en del av din ansökan:**
* Har du en eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT alternativt motsvarande förvärvad kompetens? JA/NEJ, om JA beskriv kort och tydligt din utbildning alternativt motsvarande förvärvad kompetens.
* Har du flerårig aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av Androidutveckling, företrädesvis från en stor organisation? JA/NEJ, om JA beskriv tydligt din arbetslivserfarenhet av Androidutveckling i termer av omfattning, ansvar, arbetssätt samt hur länge du arbetat inom området
* Har du flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet av test inom Android? JA/NEJ, om ja vänligen beskriv tydligt din erfarenhet inklusive omfattning (andel testarbete), ansvar samt använda testverktyg/metoder.
* Har du goda kunskaper om Android OS? JA/NEJ, om ja beskriv kort din erfarenhet, inklusive vilken version eller vilka versioner du arbetat med.
* Har du mycket goda kunskaper i svenska? JA/NEJ
* Har du goda kunskaper i engelska? JA/NEJ
* Har du svenskt medborgarskap? JA/NEJ
* Har du erfarenhet/kompetens av att ta fram lösningsarkitektur? JA/NEJ, om ja vänligen beskriv kortfattat din erfarenhet/kompetens?
* Har du erfarenhet av att designa hållbara arkitekturer för testautomatisering? JA/NEJ, om ja vänligen beskriv kortfattat din erfarenhet.
* Har du arbetslivserfarenhet av byggautomation samt av att sätta upp CI/CD-flöden för Androidutveckling? JA/NEJ, om ja vänligen beskriv kortfattat din erfarenhet.
* Har du erfarenhet av utveckling med hårda krav på kvalitet och av prestandakritiska IT-system? JA/NEJ, om ja vänligen beskriv kortfattat din erfarenhet/kompetens.
* Har du yrkeserfarenhet kring hårdvarunära utveckling knutet till Android-enheter? JA/NEJ, Om ja vänligen beskriv kortfattat din erfarenhet/kompetens kring.
* Har du erfarenhet av olika Androidspecifika testramverk, exempelvis JUnit, UI Automator, Android-emulatorer och/eller fysiska testenheter? JA/NEJ, om ja beskriv kortfattat din erfarenhet inklusive vilka ramverk du arbetat med.
* Har du erfarenhet av testrapportering och synlighet, spårbarhet (observability)? JA/NEJ, om ja vänligen beskriv kortfattat din erfarenhet.


 Vänligen notera att krav och eventuella meriter ska vara uppfyllda vid ansökningstillfället. Intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande.
   

  

 De uppgifter du lämnar i samband med din ansökan kan användas för att kontakta dig, få information och kallelser samt eventuella anställningshandlingar.
   

  

 Har du skyddade personuppgifter, referenser eller liknande information som du själv bedömer som skyddsvärd rekommenderar vi att du kontaktar ansvarig HR-konsult innan du går vidare med din ansökan. Om du vill komplettera din ansökan vänder du dig till ansvarig HR-konsult.
   

  

 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetenhet. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) genomförs innan beslut om anställning fattas. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om krigsplacering och säkerhetsprövning under https://polisen.se/krigsplacering och https://polisen.se/sakerhetsprovning
   

  

 Polismyndigheten kommer att behandla dina personuppgifter i enlighet med reglerna i EU:s dataskyddsförordning (2016/679) och annan tillämplig dataskyddsreglering. Läs mer om vår hantering av personuppgifter på https://polisen.se/personuppgifter/rekrytering
   

  

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Vi undanber oss samtal och mail från dig som vill sälja annons- och rekryteringstjänster.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**What will you do?** 




 As a Senior Data Engineer at Rebtel, you will do more than build pipelines; you'll help shape the future of our data platform and influence how data is used across the company. At Rebtel, data sits at the heart of how we build products, understand customers, optimize growth, and make decisions.
 



  





 This is a hands-on engineering role with significant ownership. You'll work across our modern data stack, build scalable data products, and help define the architecture that supports analytics, automation, and future AI initiatives.
 



  





 If you're excited by clean architecture, modern data engineering practices, and solving meaningful business problems at scale; if you care about data quality and believe trust in data is built through engineering discipline; if you enjoy solving complex problems and turning ambiguity into practical solutions; and if you're excited to experiment with new technologies and approaches, we'd love to talk.
 



**Areas Of Ownership** 



* Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines that power our Snowflake data platform
* Integrate data from a wide range of business and product systems
* Enable data activation across customer-facing and operational platforms, including CRM, customer support, and marketing tools
* Develop robust monitoring, alerting, and observability practices to ensure platform reliability
* Troubleshoot, optimize, and continuously improve data workflows and platform performance
* Design and implement scalable ELT workflows using modern data engineering practices
* Build well-structured dimensional models (facts and dimensions) that enable self-service analytics and reporting
* Implement automated testing and quality controls throughout the data lifecycle
* Ensure data is accurate, accessible, and trusted across the organization
* Work closely with analysts, product managers, engineers, marketers, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver impactful solutions
* Help translate complex business challenges into scalable data products and datasets
* Support decision-making by making data easier to discover, understand, and use
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices
* Run proof-of-concepts and contribute to strategic technology decisions
* Help define the future architecture of Rebtel's data platform
* Continuously improve engineering standards, tooling, and developer experience



**Requirements** 



* You are an excellent communicator and collaborator. We work in English, but you will hear many languages in our Stockholm office
* 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering or a similar role
* Strong SQL skills and experience building production-grade data pipelines
* Experience with modern ELT methodologies and data warehousing concepts
* Experience integrating data from multiple systems and sources
* Experience with dbt, Python, AWS, or similar cloud-based data platforms
* Strong understanding of data modeling and analytics engineering best practices
* Ability to operate independently and take ownership of technical solutions
* Experience working in fast-growing technology or digital product companies is a plus
* It's a bonus if you've been exposured to customer analytics, marketing analytics, experimentation, or machine learning workflows
* Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI is a plus
* It's a plus with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field



  





**Why Rebtel?** 




 Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. As we enter our next phase, we’re building an organisation designed for speed, ownership, and real impact, where every role contributes directly to shaping what comes next.
 



 This is a place with global ambition and a strong foundation, where ideas move quickly and decisions matter. You won’t get lost in layers of process or slow-moving structures. Instead, you’ll find the space to take ownership, collaborate across teams, and make meaningful contributions from day one. Based in Stockholm, we bring together a diverse, international team united by a shared purpose: to simplify the way people connect worldwide.
 



  





**Benefits** 




 At Rebtel, you are the most important asset and we strive to provide a comprehensive package of benefits and perks that enhance your well-being and work experience. Here are some of the things you can expect from us:
 


* Pension Plan
* Health Checkups, Influenza shots and Private Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Occupational insurance
* Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)
* Discount on gym memberships
* Bonus program
* Extra parental pay
* 30 days annual vacation
* Monday breakfasts
* Relocation Support, if you're joining us from afar, we'll assist you in making a smooth transition.



*We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

title: Power Platform Developer | SEB, Solna
description:
Low-code is a way for a bank to move fast without cutting corners. Our team makes that possible. Join us in the Power Platform team, where we work with platform adoption, governance and support, to make sure good ideas don’t end up gathering dust on a shelf or take a year to reach production.
   

  

 SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a progressive tech company powered by innovation and fuelled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together we're innovating for a sustainable society and building the tech arena of the future, a welcoming space for everyone. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? If so, you'll be interested in this opportunity!
   

  

**About the role:**
 As a Power Platform developer in our Center of Excellence, you join a team that owns the platform end to end. We handle administration and governance on the platform, and we work with business units across the bank to help them build apps, automations and AI agents that support our transformation journey.
   

  

 This is a developer role, but expect to spend a lot of time alongside other teams rather than in your own backlog. You will help projects and initiatives to succeed by providing support, guidance and training. Some weeks that might mean co-building, other weeks it could mean workshops, and sometimes it’s an honest conversation about why something shouldn’t be built the way it’s been drawn up.
   

  

**In this role you will:**
* Run enablement in practice: workshops, templates, reusable patterns, development standards, and the maker community around them
* Guide business teams through their Power Platform work, from first idea to a solution they can own and maintain themselves
* Help teams make solutions safe and compliant by default, covering environment strategy, DLP, access, agent grounding and data handling, and explain the reasoning behind it
* Contribute to how the CoE itself runs: tooling, monitoring and the platform standards we ask the bank to follow
* Follow where the platform is heading, and translate that into practical guidance for our makers
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation in automation development


**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**
* Hands-on experience building and developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform
* Experience with Copilot Studio or comparable agent tooling
* Some scripting or pro-code background such as PowerShell, C# or JavaScript, enough to extend the platform when low-code runs out
* Automation experience (i.e., RPA, PowerShell, CI/CD or any cloud-based automation tool, etc.)
* Familiarity with Azure Cloud services
* The ability to teach. You can take someone from confused to confident without taking over their keyboard
* Strong communication skills and comfort working with stakeholders at varying levels of technical fluency
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Fluency in English, written and spoken


**What we offer:**
* Agile and modern ways of working
* A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
* Extensive training and learning opportunities
* Work-life balance


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-10-19. If you have questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mikaela Ahlstrand at mikaela.ahlstrand@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.
   

  

 During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce inom Kundplattform & CRM till Handelsbanken
description:
***Vill du vara med och leda utvecklingen***
 av
 ****vår CRM-plattform som stöttar medarbetare på bankens mötesplatser?****
**Vi söker en Tech Lead**
 som vill vara med på resan när vi tar plattformen till nästa nivå.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du kommer tillsammans med Agile Product Owner vara delaktig i uppbyggnaden av vårt nya Salesforce team. Vi arbetar i tvärfunktionella team och du kommer samarbeta nära andra utvecklare och arkitekter, inom och utanför vårt område. Vi har roligt på jobbet och vårt team präglas av hög kompetens och bred erfarenhet inom både teknik och affärsverksamhet.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som Tech Lead kommer du spela en central roll i utvecklingen av systemlösningar kring bankens CRM-verktyg. I rollen arbetar du tillsammans med det agila teamet för att forma tekniska lösningar som både möter affärsbehov och tekniska krav. Du kommer att leda det tekniska arbetet tillsammans med arkitekterna under både analys- och implementationsfaserna, ta fram lösningsdesign och säkerställa att dessa är i linje med bankens arkitektur. En stor del av ditt ansvar är att proaktivt identifiera förbättringsområden och föreslå lösningar som optimerar våra processer. Som Tech Lead kommer du även dela med dig av kunskap enligt Salesforce best practise och stödja teamets utvecklare i både design- och implementationsfrågor. Rollen ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i en ny och dynamisk funktion med stor möjlighet att påverka. Vi erbjuder en arbetsmiljö där du får möjlighet att både växa tekniskt och som ledare, samtidigt som du driver nyutveckling och förbättringar i ett agilt team.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som är utvecklare och har gedigen erfarenhet av utveckling och implementation av Salesforce. Du kan arbeta självständigt och har djup förståelse och erfarenhet av olika Salesforce produkter. Vidare har du erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla användarorienterade, effektiva, och skalbara Salesforce applikationer enligt best practice i den senaste tekniken. Då vi samarbetar med hela koncernen behöver du behärska god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
   

  

 Vi söker även dig som har:
   

  

* erfarenhet av att implementera Lightning Components, Flows, Apex Controllers, Visual Force Pages, Visual Force Components, Batch Apex, Schedulers och Apex Triggers
* erfarenhet av att integrera Salesforce med externa applikationer med hjälp av tredjepartsverktyg via SOAP och REST API-integration
* erfarenhet av att leda eller varit involverad i större implementeringar av Salesforce i en större IT-organisation
* certifieringar inom Salesforce tex Salesforce Administrator, Plattform Developer, Sales cloud och Service cloud


 Som person strävar du efter att arbeta tillsammans med ditt team och ta tillvara på kollegors olika perspektiv för att nå uppsatta mål. Du kan beskriva problem för andra samt varför de behöver åtgärdas. Du anpassar din kommunikation till målgruppen och har ett pedagogiskt förhållningssätt i att vägleda och motivera andra. Det kommer naturligt att tänka i nya banor och du håller dig uppdaterad om trender inom området för att komma fram till skalbara lösningar. Du fattar självständiga beslut när det behövs baserat på verksamhetens behov och regelkrav.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
*Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.*
 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Job Location: Tumba
   

  

 Working Model: Hybrid
   

  

 Senior Platform Engineer
   

  

 At DeLaval, we use technology and innovation to support more sustainable food production worldwide. As a global leader in dairy farming solutions, we are connecting farms, data, and cloud services to create new value for farmers around the world.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join our Data Platform Team within Digital Services. You'll help build the data platform that powers analytics, AI, and data-driven innovation across DeLaval.
   

  

 The platform is build with Databricks run on AWS Cloud to provide an unified way to discover, access, and process data across the organization.
   

  

 We operate using a hub-and-spoke model, where the platform team delivers reusable capabilities while domain teams own their data products and business logic. This enables teams to work independently while benefiting from common standards and tooling.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Data Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operate reliable, secure, and cost-efficient platform capabilities that enable teams across DeLaval to develop and run data and AI products at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build and maintain a self-serve data platform using AWS services, Terraform, Databricks
* Implement and manage data mesh principles to support domain-oriented data ownership
* Design and support medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold layers) using Databricks
* Ensure platform’s scalability, observability, security and cost optimization
* Implement data governance practices including cataloguing, lineage, access control, data contracts and quality controls
* Collaborate in a Scrum team to deliver platform features in an agile, iterative manner
* Support platform users and promote best practices across teams


**Qualifications**
 To be successful in this role we believe that you have:
   

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or equivalent
* Experience working in agile/scrum delivery teams
* About 5 years of relevant experience, including 3 years with AWS Cloud Infrastructure
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., S3, Glue, Lambda, IAM, EKS, Redshift)
* Proficiency in IAM design: secrets, networking, private connectivity, service principals etc.
* Experience of working with multi account cloud infrastructure.
* Proficiency in Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CICD
* Programming skills in Python
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Nice to have: experience with Databricks: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, workflows/jobs, compute/serverless, permissions, external locations/storage credentials, account/workspace architecture


**Working at DeLaval**
 Our core values Passion, People, Professionals and Partnerships connect individuals across entities and geographies. Success is far more than knowledge – it is strongly related to behaviour. At DeLaval we are all guided by our three behaviours: Set Direction, Make Things Happen and One DeLaval.
   

  

 We Offer You a Workplace Like No Other, Where State-of-the-art Technology Goes Hand In Hand With Animal Welfare. DeLaval Is a Part Of The Tetra Laval Group Together With Tetra Pak And Sidel. In Addition, We Offer
   

  

* Secure employment and benefits from the collective agreement (occupational pension, work-related accident insurance).
* Parental leave compensation (approx. 10 percent of the employee's monthly salary).
* Wellness allowance of SEK 4 000/year.
* Private healthcare insurance.
* Flexible working hours and reduced working hours.
* 30 days paid annual leave.


**Additional Information**
 This is a full-time permanent position based at DeLaval’s headquarters in Tumba, south of Stockholm. We offer a hybrid workplace model, combining on-site work with flexibility to work remotely.
   

  

 We review applications ongoing. We do not accept applications via email, however if you have any questions regarding the role or the recruitment process don’t hesitate to contact us.
   

  

**Contact**
 Hiring manager: Jedrzej Siemienski, jedrzej.siemienski@delaval.com
   

  

 Recruiter: Mathias Gunnstedt, Mathias.gunnstedt@delaval.com
   

  

**About DeLaval**
 Our vision is to make sustainable food production possible. As a company built on innovation, we constantly work to find ways of helping our customers, dairy farmers, do more with less by providing world-leading milking equipment and solutions.
   

  

 Today, DeLaval has approximately 4,900 passionate professionals operating in more than 90 markets around the world. DeLaval is part of the Tetra Laval Group.
   

  

 See more at corporate.delaval.com
   

  

 IT & Digital Services

title: Senior Plattformsingenjör / Data Engineer (GCP)
description:

 Slutdatum: Option på förlängning

 Plats: Hybrid
   

  

**Uppdragsbeskrivning**
 Vår kund söker en senior Plattformsingenjör / Data Engineer med gedigen erfarenhet av Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Rollen är central i vidareutvecklingen och förvaltningen av en molnbaserad plattform som används av flera utvecklings- och datateam.
   

  

 Uppdraget passar dig som har arbetat hands-on med komplexa GCP-miljöer under flera år och som är van att ta ett brett tekniskt ansvar. Du behöver kunna förstå hur olika delar av en plattform hänger ihop, felsöka problem över flera tekniska lager och omsätta komplexa behov till stabila, säkra och automatiserade lösningar.
   

  

 Arbetet omfattar både löpande plattformsutveckling och långsiktiga förbättringar inom bland annat Infrastructure as Code, containerplattformar, automatiserade leveransflöden, säkerhet och tekniska arbetssätt.
   

  

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:**
* Utveckla, konfigurera och förvalta gemensamma plattformskomponenter i GCP.
* Automatisera infrastruktur och miljöer med Terraform och Infrastructure as Code.
* Arbeta med Kubernetes/GKE, containeriserade workloads samt CI/CD.
* Hantera IAM, behörigheter, nätverk och andra säkerhetsrelaterade delar av plattformen.
* Felsöka komplexa tekniska problem och förbättra plattformens stabilitet, struktur och observerbarhet.
* Utveckla återanvändbara lösningar och self-service-funktionalitet för utvecklings- och datateam.


**Skall-krav**
* Minst 8 års relevant erfarenhet inom plattformsutveckling, Data Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps eller närliggande område.
