title: Product Manager - Card
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a Product Manager for the next phase of growth.

##### **About the Role**


As a Product Manager in Qreds card domain, you take ownership of our card product, bridging the gap between card architecture, payment ecosystems, and business impact. Working alongside an Engineering Manager or Tech Lead, you drive the "why" and "what" to build scalable card infrastructure, optimize cardholder experience, and deliver real value to small businesses through daily financial tools.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Define the vision, strategy, and prioritized roadmap for Qreds Credit Card to align with Qred's commercial goals and market expansion.
* Lead qualitative and quantitative research using to optimize customer experience, spend engagement, and feature adoption.
* Partner with Engineering and UX to lead a cross-functional card team, fostering an environment of technical precision and execution.
* Own the lifecycle of card products and features from ideation to launch.
* Enhance our mobile app and expense management experience to make day-to-day financial workflows effortless for business owners.
* Monitor card performance indicators (activation, transaction volume, interchange economics), analyze market trends, and drive commercial impact across the card product space.
* Elevate our mobile app and expense management experience to turn complex day-to-day financial workflows into delightful, effortless moments for entrepreneurs.

##### **What we’re looking for**


You are a sharp, forward-thinking leader with a data-informed mindset who thrives on building alignment across teams and delivering game-changing payment products. You love high-ownership environments, get energized by unpacking complex payment and card ecosystems, and are deeply motivated to build seamless, scalable financial tools that make life easier for thousands of business owners every day.

##### **Qualifications**

* Several years of experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex products through the full development lifecycle.
* Solid background or strong expertise in mobile app development, expense management, credit cards, payment processing, or commercial card operations.
* Practical experience with structured product discovery methods, quantitative data analysis, and iterative experimentation.
* Strong technical grasp of software architecture, APIs, card management integrations, and system dependencies to collaborate effectively with engineering leads.
* Experience in fintech, card issuing, merchant processing, or other highly regulated financial environments is preferred.

##### **Why Qred?**


This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!

##### **One Last Thing**


This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.

*Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.*

title: Designer till Variant
description:
Välkommen till Variant, ett konsultföretag med stor transperens, av och för människor med stor nyfikenhet och som är generösa mot varandra. Vi vill arbeta med organisationer, där vi tillsammans ser att design- och teknikkompetens kombineras och säkerställer starka, hållbara lösningar. Vi erbjuder mer än schyssta villkor, bra lön samt möjlighet att arbeta på häftiga uppdrag tillsammans med engagerade kollegor. Vi tar transparensen till nya höjder, eftersom det är en av våra grundpelare.

  

Vi letar efter dig som vill jobba som konsult och bygga upp kultur. Du får gärna ha arbetat som konsult innan, men det är inget krav. Däremot så tror vi att du säkert har något som du brinner lite extra för i hantverket. Du kanske gillar att skapa robusta designsystem. Eller är du en stragisk tricksters som ser saker på ett nytt, brett och långtgående sätt. Kanske är du den designer som putsar pixlarna tills de är , eller älskar du research mer än allt annat?

 **Vem letar vi efter?**


Variant är summan av människorna som jobbar här, ju mer olika vi är – desto bättre! Det är nämligen det som sätter grunden för vad vi kan bli. Här kommer tankar om vem vi letar efter:

  

* Är en designförespråkare med förmåga att skapa en helhet mellan nya och befintliga tjänster/produkter.
* Jobbat minst 4 år som service, UX och eller UI designer
* Erfarenhet av flera olika researchmetoder
* Gillar att förbättra användarupplevelsen av befintliga produkter, genom att arbeta med flöde och användargränssnitt.
* Kan omsätta insikter från research till god digital design
* Skapa bra och inkluderande design
* Kunna väga en organisations affärsmål med användarnas behov
* Vill arbeta nära utvecklare och produktägare och ser tekniken som en möjliggörare
* Gärna kunskap och erfarenhet från olika system, såväl interna som externa, appar som webb

  

Du behöver självklart inte pricka in alla punkter ovan, vi söker dig som vill utvecklas!

 **Vad vi kan erbjuda**


Vår affärsmodell är enkel: Vi erbjuder bra människor. Då säger det sig självt att vi måste satsa på kunskap. För att Variant i Sverige ska växa och bli heltäckande vill vi att alla ska kunna odla sina intressen. Vill du starta en meet-up om inkluderande design? Eller kicka igång en podcast? Kanske gå på konferenser och prata om ett ämne du brinner för? Bli mentor för studenter? Eller sparra med andra Varianter som har mycket erfarenhet bakom sig? Ja tack! Huset är öppet och i Variant gör vi det som får oss att växa.

  

Vi vill öka transparensen. Därför har alla som vill möjlighet att delta på säljmöten och påverka vad som händer och inte minst var du kommer att arbeta. Vi har också lagt ut hela vår personalhandbok publikt, så vet du vad du kan förvänta dig när du börjar hos oss. Som medarbetare får du varje kvartal bonus, den beräknas på 30 procent av vinsten för varje kvartal och delas ut lika mellan alla anställda. Vi vill investera i dig – och hoppas att du vill investera i oss! Variant är nämligen ett medarbetarägt företag där du får möjlighet att köpa in dig om du så önskar. Dessutom är lön inget vi håller hemligt och försöker pressa ner, alla vet vad kollegorna har i lön. Och självklart så är ledningens löner också publika .  

Löneläget för denna tjänst är knutet till antal års erfarnhet i yrket, men spannet är emallan 40 000 – 68 000.

  

En gång i månaden har vi något vi kallar Variantdag. En "innedag" där vi samlas för att utvecklas tillsammans och inte minst träffas, ha roligt och lära känna varandra ännu bättre. Med det sagt är det viktigt för Variant att det ska gynna hela din familj. Vi vill inte ha övertid. Vi underlättar träning – om du väljer att köpa gymkort eller uppgradera din hemmaträning är upp till dig. Vi har en fantastisk handbok att läsa lite mer om det mesta. (Pst, pro-tip: kolla in "Andra fördelar och fördelar")

  

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig

***Om Variant***  

*Variant är ett konsultbolag med cirka 40 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg och Linköping. Vi hjälper våra kunder lösa komplexa utmaningar och skapa digitala produkter och tjänster som gör verklig skillnad. Hos oss finns bland annat UX- och tjänstedesigners, utvecklare, lösningsarkitekter, strateger och andra specialister. Vi arbetar både som konsulter integrerade i våra kunders team och med uppdrag där vi sätter samman team och tar ett större ansvar för leveransen.*

title: Customer Journey Owner (vikariat)
description:
*På Stim arbetar vi för att musikskapare och musikförlag ska få ersättning när deras musik används. Genom att förvalta upphovsrättigheter bidrar vi till ett levande musikliv och skapar förutsättningar för framtidens musikskapande.*
**Om tjänsten**
 Nu söker vi en Customer Journey Owner till vårt Service Design-team för ett vikariat på cirka ett år.
   

  

 Som Customer Journey Owner får du en viktig roll i att utveckla och förbättra kundupplevelsen genom att samla insikter, skapa struktur och driva prioriterade initiativ framåt.
   

  

 Du blir en del av Service Design-teamet, bestående av åtta medarbetare, som arbetar med att utveckla och förbättra Stims övergripande upplevelser för våra olika målgrupper. Teamet ansvarar för att samla insikter, identifiera utvecklingsbehov och skapa förutsättningar för att rätt initiativ prioriteras och genomförs. Arbetet sker tvärfunktionellt och i nära samarbete med verksamhet, produkt, design och teknik.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Customer Journey Owner ansvarar du för den löpande utvecklingen och förvaltningen av den målgruppsresa du ansvarar för. Du håller samman arbetet kring kundresans roadmap, identifierar behov och förbättringsmöjligheter samt driver initiativ från idé till genomförande och uppföljning.
   

  

 Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och ett nära samarbete med olika delar av organisationen. Du faciliterar forum och möten, skapar samsyn kring prioriteringar och säkerställer att beslut omsätts i konkreta aktiviteter. Du fångar också upp nya insikter, förändrade förutsättningar och beroenden som påverkar kundresan och ser till att dessa omhändertas genom tydliga prioriteringar och beslut.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**
 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* förvalta och utveckla kundresans roadmap
* identifiera och prioritera behov och förbättringsmöjligheter utifrån kundinsikter och verksamhetsmål
* driva prioriterade initiativ från idé till genomförande och uppföljning
* facilitera forum och dialoger som skapar samsyn, beslut och framdrift
* hantera beroenden, risker och prioriteringar som påverkar kundresan
* samordna arbetet mellan verksamhet, design, produkt och teknik
* följa upp effekter och säkerställa att genomförda initiativ skapar värde för kund och verksamhet.


**Om dig**
 För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du:
   

  

* har erfarenhet av att driva initiativ, förändringsarbete eller utvecklingsinsatser i en tvärfunktionell miljö
* har arbetat nära produkt-, design- och utvecklingsteam samt har god förståelse för hur kund- och verksamhetsbehov omsätts till digital utveckling
* har erfarenhet av roadmaparbete, prioritering och koordinering mellan flera intressenter
* är van att facilitera möten, workshops och forum samt skapa struktur och framdrift i komplexa frågor
* använder kundinsikter och verksamhetsdata som underlag för prioriteringar och beslut
* kommunicerar tydligt, bygger förtroende och säkerställer att beslut följs upp och omsätts i nästa steg
* har erfarenhet av Jira Product Discovery, Jira eller liknande verktyg


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av**
* Customer Journey Management, Service Design eller Product Management
* verksamhetsutveckling eller digital tjänsteutveckling
* agila och iterativa arbetssätt, inklusive discovery- och deliveryprocesser
* User Story Mapping och Customer Journey Mapping


 Vi tror att du är en strukturerad och drivande person som trivs med att skapa riktning och framdrift tillsammans med andra. Du har lätt för att bygga samarbeten, navigera mellan olika perspektiv och skapa samsyn när flera behov och prioriteringar behöver balanseras.
   

  

 Du växlar obehindrat mellan ett strategiskt helhetsperspektiv och ett mer operativt fokus, och motiveras av att omsätta insikter och beslut till konkreta resultat.
   

  

**Övrigt**
 Tjänsten är ett föräldraledighetsvikariat på cirka 12 månader. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse, men med fördel i november. Hos Stim arbetar du i en organisation som brinner för musikskapares villkor och musikalisk mångfald. Vi är cirka 160 medarbetare och sitter i nyrenoverade lokaler på Hornsgatan i Stockholm.
   

  

**Låter det intressant?** 
 Välkommen med din ansökan och CV, vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Marcus Janzon eller ansvarig rekryterare Fanny Gabrielsson. Facklig kontakt för tjänsten är ordförande i vår lokala Unionenklubb Eva Botmar.

title: Senior Game Designer | Candy Crush Saga
description:
**Craft:**
 Games Design & Production
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Are you passionate about creating memorable player experiences that delight millions of players every day? Do you thrive on solving complex design challenges that span multiple systems, teams and player journeys?
   

  

 We're looking for a strategic and creative Senior Game Designer to join the Player Value team in Candy Crush Saga. In this role, you'll shape some of the most important moments in a player's experience, from their first session through their long-term journey, creating experiences that maximize player value, engagement and delight. You'll have the opportunity to influence the game at a holistic level, working across multiple initiatives and collaborating with teams throughout Candy Crush Saga.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

 As a Senior Game Designer in the Player Value team, you'll work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment alongside Product Managers, UX Designers, Data Scientists, Engineers and other Game Designers to identify and redesign the moments that matter most to players.
   

  

 You'll think beyond individual features, taking a holistic view of the player journey to create cohesive experiences that improve onboarding, progression, motivation, retention and long-term engagement. From reimagining the first-time user experience to evolving key player journeys, you'll connect insights across the game and drive design strategies that elevate the overall player experience.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the design of high-impact player experiences that span multiple features, systems and teams.
* Shape and evolve key player journeys, including onboarding, progression, rewards and other critical moments that influence long-term engagement.
* Develop a holistic vision for player value, ensuring experiences feel meaningful, rewarding and cohesive throughout the game.
* Drive discovery and concept development for strategic opportunities that improve player satisfaction, engagement and business outcomes.
* Collaborate across multiple product teams to align experiences into a seamless player journey.
* Create clear design documentation, player journey maps and experience frameworks to communicate vision and drive execution.
* Use qualitative research, player feedback and quantitative data to identify friction points, uncover opportunities and validate design decisions.
* Stay informed on market trends, player expectations and emerging design practices, bringing fresh thinking into the team.
* Champion systems thinking, ensuring new experiences complement the broader Candy Crush ecosystem and reinforce long-term player value.


**Skills**
* Strategic Thinker – Able to zoom out and design experiences from a player journey perspective, balancing immediate needs with long-term engagement.
* Systems Designer – Comfortable designing across interconnected features and understanding how multiple systems combine to shape player experience.
* Player-Centric – Passionate about understanding player motivations and creating experiences that surprise, delight and build lasting relationships with the game.
* Analytical – Uses data, experimentation and player insights to inform decisions and continuously improve experiences.
* Collaborative Influencer – Excels at working across disciplines and multiple teams, building alignment and driving initiatives that span organizational boundaries.
* Creative Problem Solver – Brings innovative thinking to complex design challenges, identifying opportunities to create meaningful player value at scale.
* Market Awareness – Deep understanding of casual and free-to-play games, player psychology and evolving industry trends.


**Bonus Points**
* Experience designing player journeys, onboarding, progression, reward systems or engagement loops.
* Experience driving initiatives that span multiple product teams or game systems.
* Experience with UX, service design or product strategy.
* Experience leading discovery work and defining product vision for ambiguous problem spaces.


**About King**
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: CRO & Experimentation Lead
description:
*We offer you an exciting position in a dynamic and fast-paced industry! Here, you’ll have the chance to work with helpful and knowledgeable colleagues from across the Nordics, making every day unique and inspiring.*
*We are now looking for an CRO & Experimentation Lead to join our Marketing & eCommerce team in Stockholm and help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at Apollo.*
 As we are still in the early stages of building our experimentation capability, this is a unique opportunity to take a leading role in shaping how experimentation is done across the organization. You will define ways of working, build engagement, introduce best practices, and help establish a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
   

  

 Combining strategic ownership with hands-on execution, you will work closely with Product Owners, UX Designers, Analysts and Software Engineers to turn insights into experiments that drive measurable impact on customer experience and business performance.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
 As our CRO & Experimentation Lead, you will own the vision, roadmap and execution of Apollo's experimentation agenda. You will be the driving force behind embedding experimentation into how we develop products, optimize customer journeys and make business decisions. By bringing together data, customer insights and cross-functional collaboration, you will help create a culture where learning and continuous improvement become part of everyday decision-making.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Define and drive the experimentation roadmap across our digital products and customer journeys.
* Turn customer insights, business opportunities and data into clear hypotheses for experiments.
* Design, execute, analyze and communicate experiments and their outcomes.
* Manage stakeholders and partner closely with Product Owners, UX Designers, Software Engineering teams, Analysts, eCommerce & Content teams, to identify opportunities and prioritize initiatives.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights to uncover customer needs, friction points and optimization opportunities.
* Share learnings and recommendations that help teams make better, evidence-based decisions.
* Coach and support teams in adopting experimentation best practices and data-driven ways of working.
* Continuously improve our experimentation processes, frameworks and toolkit to maximize impact and scalability.


**Skills & Requirements**
* Experience leading experimentation programs in e-commerce or digital product environments.
* Proven experience managing the full experimentation lifecycle, from hypothesis and build to insights and business decisions.
* Strong understanding of experimentation statistics and how to design and evaluate A/B tests.
* Experience working with experimentation both strategically and hands-on.
* Ability to combine quantitative and qualitative insights to identify experimentation opportunities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills with the ability to build engagement around experimentation.
* Experience coaching teams and establishing experimentation best practices.
* Hands-on experience with experimentation platforms such as Optimizely, GrowthBook, Dynamic Yield, VWO, or similar.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML and CSS, with the ability to build and support client-side experiments.
* Strong analytical skills and experience working with digital analytics and behavioral insights tools such as GA4, FullStory, Contentsquare or similar.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in e-commerce, including 3+ years in CRO and experimentation.
* University degree in Business, Digital Product Development, Analytics, Computer Science, Marketing, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Additional training or certifications in experimentation, CRO, analytics, statistics or product management are considered a plus.
* Professional proficiency in English and Swedish, both written and spoken.


**Personal Qualities**
* Self-driven and comfortable taking ownership.
* Analytical, curious, structured and motivated by continuous learning.
* A strong relationship-builder who can influence through trust and collaboration.
* Pragmatic and hands-on, with the ability to move between strategy and execution.
* Confident working with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Collaborative and passionate about building a strong experimentation culture.


 As CRO & Experimentation Lead you will be a part of the Marketing & eCommerce team and report to Head of CRO & User Experience.
   

  

 The position is a permanent full-time position, based at our headquarters in Norrtull, Stockholm.
   

  

 Does this sound like an opportunity for you? Send in your application today - we truly look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

 Please note that selection takes place on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait too long.

title: Produktägare för digitala kanaler
company: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency
description:
Myndigheten för civilt försvar
   

  

*Myndigheten för civilt försvar är den ledande, inriktande och samordnande myndigheten i det civila försvaret. Vi säkerställer att samhället är förberett för kris, höjd beredskap och krig.*
 Vi gör Sverige redo. Vill du vara vår nästa kollega?
   

  

 Myndigheten för civilt försvar ansvarar för några av Sveriges viktigaste kommunikationskanaler för krisberedskap och civilt försvar, bland annat myndighetens huvudwebbplats mcf.se, webbplatsen Krisinformation.se och appen Krisinformation. Nu behöver vi förstärka vårt team med fler produktägare.
   

  

 Ditt ansvar och dina arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Som produktägare ansvarar du för att driva utveckling och förvaltning av våra kanaler genom att identifiera och prioritera behov, planera utveckling och sprintar, paketera lämpliga leveranser, definiera krav och acceptanskriterier. Du har även ansvar för backloggen och arbetar tillsammans med interna och externa utvecklare och UX-designers.
   

  

 I rollen som produktägare ansvarar du också för att kanalerna utvecklas i linje med våra strategier och användarnas behov. Du säkerställer att vi jobbar utifrån de effektkartor som finns och följer upp effektmål. Du deltar i dialoger med intressenter och har ett tätt samarbete med redaktörer och kommunikatörer.
   

  

 Tillsammans med övriga produktägare, förvaltningsledare och digital strateg planerar du användningen av resurser och konsulter och strävar efter synergieffekter i myndighetens förvaltning och utveckling.
   

  

 Dina kunskaper och kompetenser
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* akademisk utbildning inom kommunikations- eller webbutvecklingsområdet, eller annan utbildning kombinerat med arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren kan bedöma som likvärdig
* erfarenhet av kravställning till utvecklare och prioritering av backlogg
* erfarenhet av webbutveckling i rollen som produktägare, webbansvarig eller motsvarande
* goda kunskaper om relevant lagstiftning, till exempel lagen om tillgänglighet till digital offentlig service och GDPR.


**Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har**
* erfarenhet av att driva webbprojekt i rollen som projektledare eller produktägare
* arbetat i Optimizely/Episerver CMS eller annat publiceringssystem
* arbetat med apputveckling
* arbetat i tvärfunktionella agila team
* arbetat som scrum master
* arbetat utifrån ett designsystem
* erfarenhet av att jobba med externa leverantörer
* erfarenhet av att jobba med effektkartläggning och uppföljning av effektmål


 I allt vårt arbete, både internt och externt, ska vi agera utifrån den statliga värdegrunden. Som alla medarbetare och ledare hos oss förväntas du agera utifrån myndighetens förhållningssätt.
   

  

 Förhållningssätten gäller i vardag, kris och krig. De ska ses som en helhet och bygger på varandra; samarbetsinriktad – proaktiv - handlingskraftig.
   

  

 Läs mer om våra förhållningssätt
   

  

 Vi ser att samarbetsförmåga samt ett mål- och resultatorienterat arbetssätt är viktiga för att lyckas i rollen. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Om anställningen
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig en anställning tillsvidare på heltid som inleds med en provanställning.
   

  

 Din placeringsort kommer att vara Karlstad eller Stockholm och resor i anställningen förekommer.
   

  

 Majoriteten av våra anställningar innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Vid placering i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. De flesta medarbetare på Myndigheten för civilt försvar är krigsplacerade.
   

  

 Om oss
   

  

 Enheten för utveckling och förvaltning är en av fem enheter på kommunikationsavdelningen. På enheten finns idag sju medarbetare, och vi är placerade i både Karlstad och Stockholm.
   

  

 Vi har aktivitetsbaserat kontor där du kan välja arbetsplats efter egna behov. Du kan också ha möjlighet till distansarbete i viss omfattning.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig också en möjlighet att ta ut friskvårdstimme och du får även ett friskvårdsbidrag. För dig som statligt anställd finns också förmånliga semestervillkor.
   

  

 Alla vi som arbetar på Myndigheten för civilt försvar förväntas och ska bidra till ökad jämställdhet och likabehandling för en arbetsmiljö och ett samhälle fritt från diskriminering.
   

  

 Läs mer om vår organisation, förmåner och hur det är att arbeta hos oss
   

  

 Vill du veta mer?
   

  

 Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta chef Marie Kämpe. Fackliga företrädare är Fredrik Höglund (Saco-S), Hannah Wikander (ST) och Ann Britt Paradis (SEKO). Samtliga nås via växelnummer 0771-240 240.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 16 oktober 2026**
 Anställningsform Tillsvidare med provanställning Anställningens omfattning Heltid Antal lediga befattningar 1 Sysselsättningsgrad 100% Ort Karlstad eller Stockholm Län Värmlands län Land Sverige Referensnummer 2026/202 Publicerat 2026-10-06

title: Brand Designer
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Brand Designer to join the Brand & Creative team and help raise the bar on how Tandem looks, feels, and shows up across product UI, marketing, events, and everything in between.
   

  

 You'll work closely with marketing, product, and the founders to evolve our visual identity, scale our design system, and produce high-quality creative for campaigns, launches, congresses, and partnerships across Europe.
   

  

 We want someone who'll come in and work across the team from day one, and who's genuinely interested in growing into more ownership over time. This is a role where you'll have real output and real impact on our brand and design system. Both are still actively being built, and there are some genuinely exciting challenges coming our way over the next year.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Evolve and maintain Tandem's visual identity across typography, color, illustration, motion, and photography direction.
* Own and grow our Design Language System (Figma) so the rest of the team can self-serve on common assets.
* Design marketing campaigns end-to-end: web pages, social, paid ads, email, video thumbnails, presentation decks.
* Produce event and congress materials including booth design, print, swag, and signage, including for partner-led launches.
* Partner with Product Marketing on launch creative (product visuals, case studies, one-pagers, sales collateral).
* Work alongside our other Brand Designers to set creative direction and review each other's work.
* Collaborate with Product Design when brand and product surfaces meet (onboarding, in-app moments, marketing-adjacent UI).
* Brief and direct external partners (illustrators, motion designers, photographers, agencies) when we need extra firepower.


 What we're looking for
   

  

* 3 to 5+ years of brand design experience, ideally with time spent in-house at a fast-moving B2B or consumer tech company.
* A portfolio that shows strong typographic craft, systems thinking, and range across digital and print.
* Confidence designing at both ends of the spectrum, from a polished hero campaign one week to a quick social asset the next.
* Fluent in Figma; comfortable with motion tools (After Effects, Rive, or similar) and the Adobe suite.
* Strong written and verbal English; able to brief, present, and defend creative choices clearly.
* Bonus: experience in healthcare, regulated industries, or designing for multiple European markets.


 How we work
   

  

* We move fast and ship often. Decisions happen in small groups, and design has a seat at the table early.
* We document in Notion, design in Figma, and ship through close collaboration with engineering and marketing.
* We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based full time on-site at our HQ in the heart of Stockholm, where you'll collaborate, connect, and help build our culture.


 How to apply
   

  

 Send a short note about why this role interests you and a portfolio link. We review applications on a rolling basis.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive salary & company stock options
* 30 days/year of paid vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag) plus an additional 6,000 SEK yearly to spend on other health related initiatives
* Generous Parental leave top-up for new parents
* Private Medical Insurance to stay healthy
* Mental health support through our partner Mindler
* Pension program
* Social and team-building activities (off-sites, after works, winter/summer parties)
* An opportunity to make a real positive impact in the world of healthcare
* Work with some of the best minds in AI, healthcare, and engineering.


*We review our benefits packages on a regular basis and might modify our benefits from time to time.*
**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Consumer Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about building true consumer preference—turning data and insights into real user and business impact?
   

  

 At Instabee, we are on a mission to become the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. We are now looking for a Consumer Analyst to join our Consumer Department. In this role, you will play a fundamental part in building the analytical foundation and insights required to ensure our organization is aligned, informed, and accountable for delivering a superior consumer experience across all markets.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Consumer Analyst, you will translate complex data and consumer signals into clear, actionable insights that can drive strategic and tactical impact. Partnering with teams across Data & Analytics, Product, Design, Operations, Strategy and Market to understand challenges, synthesize insights from diverse sources, and co-create solutions grounded in consumer and business relevance.
   

  

 Your goal is to build a solid foundation for consumer, brand, and experience analytics, making insights accessible and actionable company-wide. Whether you are mapping the behavior of different consumer segments, uncovering what drives long-term retention, or tracking the impact of a new product feature, you will play a key role in guiding our journey toward becoming the undisputed #1 service in all our markets.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Manage the Consumer Scorecard: Define and evolve our core KPIs (NPS, User ratings, Brand preference, CSAT, MAU, Consumer base metrics, Operational metrics etc.) to ensure a trusted, single source of truth for our performance across the full consumer journey and lifecycle.
* Analyze Loyalty & Retention: Conduct cohort and retention analysis to identify the key drivers of consumer satisfaction and long-term loyalty. You’ll explore how different user segments behave and evolve, and translate user and service delivery insights into cross-functional guidance for the most effective ways to win, delight, and retain our consumers.
* Analyze Consumer Behavior: Dive deep into user behavior across web, app, communications and customer service channels. You will analyze funnels and identify drop-off points to provide concrete product and experience recommendations. This includes proactively identifying tracking gaps and defining what needs to be measured and how, to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable data.
* Translate Data into Action: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, actionable insights. You will provide a holistic lens to ensure we deliver a seamless and superior experience across the entire consumer journey.
* Co-create Analytical Foundations: Partner with data and tech teams to ensure our data collection is high-quality, scalable, and reliable. You’ll help shape the tracking and data structures (e.g., GA4, BigQuery) required to turn digital behavior into trustworthy insights.
* Drive Performance Insights: Enable data-driven decision-making through forecasting, trend analysis, and the development of automated dashboards in Tableau, Steep or similar tools.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the consumer analytics partner for teams across Instabee, helping them move past the "what" to understand the "why" behind consumer behavior.
* Drive Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests—taking ownership from the initial hypothesis to the final conclusion and recommended next steps.


**Your profile**
 You are an analytical problem-solver with a natural drive to uncover patterns and understand exactly what drives consumer behavior and business performance. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by creating real-world results rather than theoretical perfection. You don't just provide data; you see it as your mission to provide the actionable insights that enable our teams to deliver a great consumer experience and our business to grow.
   

  

**Experience & Mindset**
* Analytical Experience: 4-5+ years of experience in consumer analytics, digital analytics or a related field - ideally within a fast-paced service or e-commerce environment.
* Commercial Curiosity: You have a strong business acumen and a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers. You focus on what is relevant and actionable for the business, and proactively surface insights and opportunities.
* Problem Solver: Strong analytical and numerical skills with a business-oriented mindset. You excel at bringing structure to ambiguous problems and can navigate complex datasets to find the most impactful answers.
* Communication: You can translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable narratives for diverse stakeholders. You communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership.
* Collaboration: Team player who enjoys working across Product, Tech, and Business teams to develop insights and build solutions together.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, IT, Statistics, Business, or other relevant field.


**Analytical toolkit**
* Consumer Analytics: Proven ability to synthesize various internal and external consumer data into holistic consumer analytics and insights.
* Digital Analytics: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, GA4, or similar behavioral tracking platforms.
* Data Foundations: Proficiency in SQL and Python or similar, and experience working with large datasets.
* Visualization: Ability to build and maintain clear dashboards and funnels that give our teams an ongoing view of consumer health (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Steep).
* AI coding tools: Experience in using AI tools in your analytical work is an advantage.
* Experimentation: Hands-on experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests is an advantage.
* Tracking: Knowledge of digital tracking implementation and Google Tag Manager is an advantage.


**What You'll Get**
 We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!
   

  

**Benefits**
 Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:
   

  

* Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
* Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
* Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
* Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
* A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
* Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


**Get to know us**
 In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. title: Sr. Fullstack Engineer – Frontend | Content Experience
description:
At TV4, technology, innovation, news journalism, sports and entertainment come together.
   

  

 Every week, around eight million people use TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo. How users find, discover and engage with content is central to the overall experience, from the first search to the next recommendation.
   

  

 We are now looking for a
 **Sr Fullstack Engineer with a frontend focus** 
 to join Content Experience, the area responsible for helping people find the right content, at the right time, on the right platform.
   

  

**Why this role matters**
 Content Experience is the part of TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo that users interact with when looking for something to watch. A large and constantly changing catalogue of content needs to be easy to discover, navigate and choose from.
   

  

 The experience needs to be fast and intuitive for millions of users across different screens and platforms. This places high demands on both the technical solutions and our understanding of how people actually use our products.
   

  

 You will work close to the actual user experience and solve technically complex problems where the result of what you build is directly visible to the user.
   

  

**Why you might want to join us**
 You want to work closely with product and design and like seeing a clear connection between technical decisions and what actually reaches the user.
   

  

 Your technical strength is in frontend, but you see yourself as a software engineer rather than a specialist in one particular part of the stack. You are comfortable moving across the stack when the problem requires it and want to understand the systems behind the experience you are building.
   

  

 You enjoy combining technical depth with product understanding and taking responsibility from idea and hypothesis through implementation, follow up and continued development.
   

  

 You see AI as a natural part of modern software development and are curious about how new tools and ways of working can help you and the team build better products.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Content Experience is a cross functional team where engineering works closely with product and design. We also collaborate with other engineering teams to connect our solutions with the rest of TV4's technical platform.
   

  

 The team has significant technical ownership and is responsible for its solutions all the way to production. The work is characterised by a high degree of autonomy and a close connection between technical decisions, product and users.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build and evolve user experiences in React and TypeScript
* Take technical responsibility for frontend architecture, quality, performance and long term sustainability
* Work across the stack, from client and APIs to backend services when the problem requires it
* Build solutions that help users discover, navigate and choose content
* Drive technical initiatives and contribute to architecture and technology decisions
* Turn user needs into working technical solutions together with product and design
* Use AI tools as a natural part of the development process


**About You**
 You are an experienced fullstack engineer with a clear focus on modern frontend development and mature engineering judgement. You can move from a user problem to a technical solution, understand what actually needs to be solved and make well founded technical decisions even when the problem is not fully defined.
   

  

 We believe you:
   

  

* Have deep experience with React, TypeScript and modern web development
* Are comfortable with backend development, APIs and integrations
* Have a strong understanding of frontend architecture, performance, quality and long term sustainability
* Have experience working in modern cloud based product environments
* Understand how frontend applications interact with underlying services and systems
* Can move between the bigger picture and technical detail
* Communicate clearly and work well in a cross functional product team


 It is a plus if you have experience with:
   

  

* React Native
* Go
* GraphQL
* Streaming or media platforms
* Search, recommendation systems or personalised user experiences
* High traffic consumer products


**Current Tech Stack**
**Backend:** 
 Go, Node.js
   

  

**Frontend:** 
 React, React Native, TypeScript
   

  

**Cloud:** 
 AWS
   

  

**Databases:** 
 PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
   

  

**DevOps & Observability:** 
 GitHub Actions, Terraform, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
   

  

**AI & Developer Tooling:** 
 Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, CLI/MCP integrations
   

  

**Productivity:** 
 Linear, Notion, Slack
   

  

**What TV4 Offers**
* Short paths from idea to decision in a senior technology organisation with high autonomy for both teams and individuals
* The opportunity to influence how millions of users find and discover content
* A culture that values sustainable technical solutions over quick fixes
* Colleagues with strong technical expertise and a high degree of ownership
* The ability to properly disconnect after work. We have dedicated on call arrangements with voluntary participation and do not expect you to be available outside working hours
* A modern office with gym, restaurant, parking garage and rooftop terrace

**Practical information**

 We review applications and conduct interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Frontend Team Lead – Simulation Software
description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to develop web-based functionality for COMSOL Multiphysics® and related products. In this hands-on role, you will combine software development in TypeScript and Vue with technical leadership, team management, and coordination of the team’s development projects, working on software used by engineers and researchers around the world.About COMSOLCOMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.RoleBased in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.Your main focus will be web frontend development for functionality that extends how our customers work with simulation software. This includes tools for managing simulation models and data, running and interacting with simulations, and making simulation functionality available to different users and computing environments. One example is the Model Manager, our process and data management system for simulation modeling. Other projects cover areas such as simulation apps, computational workflows, and functionality for deploying and using simulation models in new contexts.The projects evolve together with the COMSOL product suite, and you will have the opportunity to work on both established functionality and new product areas. The common challenge is to create intuitive web interfaces for sophisticated engineering software, often bringing together frontend development with complex underlying functionality and large amounts of technical data.As team lead, you will remain closely involved in software development while also managing the team and its projects. You will write and review code, contribute to product and technical design, make technical decisions, plan development projects, and guide and support the developers in the team. You will be responsible for creating an environment where the team can deliver high-quality software and grow professionally.Our web frontends are part of engineering software products rather than continuously deployed web services. The functionality you develop is released as part of software that our customers install and operate in their own environments. This brings challenges in areas such as compatibility, upgrades, performance, security, and long-term maintainability, and calls for careful design of functionality that will remain part of the products for years.QualificationsFor this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer who combines strong technical skills with the ability to manage a development team and its projects. We are looking for the following qualifications:
   

  

* M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related field.
* Excellent programming skills and several years of professional software development experience.
* Experience developing substantial web frontends using TypeScript or JavaScript and a modern frontend framework.
* Experience taking technical responsibility for software projects or significant areas of a product.
* Good communication and organizational skills, with the ability to set priorities, make decisions, and support other developers in their work.


 Experience with the following will be highly valued:
   

  

* Vue, React, or similar component-based frontend frameworks.
* Managing or coordinating a software development team.
* Project management within software development.
* Mentoring developers and providing constructive technical feedback.
* Planning larger development projects and coordinating work between developers.
* Designing and evolving user interfaces for complex applications.
* Large software projects and mature codebases.
* Software that is installed and operated in customer environments.


 No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.Working at COMSOLAt COMSOL, frontend development is closely connected to the products as a whole. You will work on functionality that makes sophisticated simulation capabilities accessible in new ways, as part of an organization where many different areas of expertise contribute to the same product family.New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape both the software and the development of your team, while remaining closely involved in hands-on software development.We also offer:
   

  

* A competitive salary
* Individual pension plans
* Sponsored gym membership
* Work-life balance with regular working hours


 This role is primarily based in our Stockholm office, where in-person collaboration is an important part of working with and supporting the team. We also offer flexibility to work from home when compatible with the needs of the team and the role.To ApplyDoes this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish using the form below. Make sure to include:
   

  

* Cover letter
* CV
* University diploma with grades


 Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.For more information, contact us at tel. 08-412 95 00.We review applications continuously.

title: Wireless Software Engineer
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.  

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.  

Keysight is seeking an exceptional RAN-focused wireless software engineer with deep 3GPP expertise to architect and advance cutting-edge test, emulation, and validation solutions that power innovation across the entire wireless ecosystem—from devices and chipsets to network infrastructure and Open RAN. You’ll work close to standards and real implementations, translating specifications into robust software capabilities that enable customers to validate conformance, interoperability, and performance across the RAN lifecycle.  

This is an ideal opportunity for a thought leader from a leading RAN organization who thrives at the intersection of **3GPP specs**, **real network behavior**, and **high-quality software**—where you'll have direct influence on industry standards and real-world wireless innovation.  


Responsibilities:
**What you’ll do*** Architect and deliver sophisticated software capabilities aligned to **3GPP LTE/NR** (e.g., RRC, PDCP/RLC/MAC, PHY interactions, procedures, state machines, timers, KPI/measurement semantics) that set new standards for performance and reliability.
* Transform evolving requirements (3GPP releases, operator acceptance needs, O-RAN priorities) into elegant software designs, robust test workflows, and reusable components that define best practices across the industry.
* Engineer and lead sophisticated automation and tooling for **protocol conformance**, **interoperability**, and **performance validation** across complex RAN-facing scenarios that solve real-world deployment challenges.
* Partner with world-class cross-functional experts (systems, RF, protocol, product, customers/partners) to rapidly reproduce field issues, uncover root causes in complex behaviors, and deliver elegant solutions with deep technical rigor.
* Produce high-impact technical artifacts—design docs, test plans, trace/pcap interpretations, and technical notes—that withstand rigorous review from industry-leading telecom engineers and become reference materials for the field.
* Shape the evolution of next-generation RAN architectures including **Open RAN / O-RAN** interfaces and multi-vendor ecosystems, positioning yourself at the forefront of wireless industry transformation.

**What you’ll work with*** **Open RAN / RAN & Core validation:** automated suites enabling conformance, interoperability, performance, security, and energy-efficiency validation across the test lifecycle.
* **5G network emulation:** solutions covering NR, sub-6 and mmWave use cases and test domains; software paired with network emulation platforms to emulate 5G NR network behavior and configure standards-compliant testing.
* **RAN measurement & optimization tooling (as applicable):** field test/verification support for advanced 5G NR technologies like DSS, beamforming, massive MIMO, and O-RAN.

Qualifications:
* Strong, hands-on expertise in **3GPP LTE/NR** with a clear RAN focus (e.g., L1/L2/L3 procedures, scheduling concepts, mobility, bearers, signaling flows, performance metrics).
* Proven track record of professional software engineering excellence (typically **8+ years**, but we value transformative impact and strategic scope over tenure alone).
* Strong coding skills in **C/C++** (and/or modern Python for automation/tooling); comfortable in **Linux** development environments.
* Proven ability to debug distributed/real-time systems: logs, traces, protocol analyzers, KPIs, timing, performance bottlenecks.
* Exceptional technical communication in English (written and verbal), with a talent for translating complex, spec-driven topics into elegant, implementable requirements that inspire cross-functional teams.

**Preferred qualifications*** Experience with **RAN product development** (gNB/eNB), RAN performance optimization, or feature verification in complex system environments.
* Familiarity with **O-RAN** architecture/interfaces (O-RU/O-DU/O-CU, fronthaul, RIC concepts) and multi-vendor integration challenges.
* Experience with CI/CD, test frameworks, containers, and/or cloud-based deployment environments.
* Prior exposure to standards work (3GPP RAN1/2/4/5) or strong experience implementing features directly from evolving specs.

**What success looks like*** You quickly establish credibility by translating ambiguous, spec-heavy problems into concrete implementations and testable outcomes.
* You raise quality and repeatability: better automation, clearer diagnostics, and fewer bugs.
* You help steer solution direction by identifying what matters most to RAN engineers, labs, and operators—and making it real in software.
* You will thrive working with a highly technical, cross-disciplinary team building solutions used across the wireless ecosystem.

title: Confidential client - Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer**
----------------------------


Some developers love building something new. Others love keeping big systems fast and stable. This role is for the one who gets restless doing only one of them.

**Our client is a tech consultancy in Stockholm and is looking for a backend or full-stack engineer to join.** One project starts as a startup's whiteboard sketch with a deadline attached. The next is an enterprise platform where a bad deploy ends up in someone's quarterly report. You'll own the backend and the infrastructure for both.


At many consultancies, you get placed with a client and rarely see your colleagues again. This one works the other way. The office is busy most days, and shared lunches, after-work evenings, and hackathons keep people connected between and during assignments.

**A typical year (give or take)**
---------------------------------

**The startup stretches:** a blank repo, a small team and a product that has to exist by spring. You pick the framework, set up the pipeline and ship the first version.

**The enterprise stretches:** an existing platform, real traffic and stakeholders who care a lot about uptime. You find the bottlenecks, harden the infrastructure and help the client's own team move faster.

**Every day in between:** AI in your toolbox, colleagues who like talking shop, and a lunch table that fills up.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the engine.** Design backend systems in Python, and choose Django, FastAPI or Flask because the project needs it, not out of habit.
* **Own the road to production.** CI/CD, containers and infrastructure as code on GCP or AWS. If it ships, you had a hand in how.
* **Make AI earn its place.** Put AI features into real products, and use AI tools every day without letting quality slip.
* **Raise the bar together.** Work with architects, DevOps engineers and frontend specialists who debate good design because they care about it.

**Who are you?**
----------------


You probably started by taking something apart just to see how it worked. Somewhere along the way Python became your tool of choice, and you discovered you like the infrastructure under the code almost as much as the code itself.


You'd probably describe yourself as:

* **Seasoned:** [5+] years building backend or fullstack systems. Enough to have strong opinions, and to know when to drop them.
* **A natural context-switcher:** you've worked as a consultant or across several projects, and a new codebase excites you more than it scares you.
* **Curious about the why:** you want to know what the code is for and what value it creates, not only how it's written.
* **AI-practical:** coding assistants and agents are part of your daily work, and [you've shipped AI features to production].

**Tech skills:**

* Python, with production experience in Django, FastAPI or Flask
* GCP or AWS
* Docker and Kubernetes
* Terraform or similar infrastructure as code
* CI/CD pipelines you've built and run yourself

**Bonus:** React or Next.js, or experience building a product from scratch.

**Language:** fluent Swedish and English. Both are a must.

**Buzzword bingo:** Python, Django, FastAPI, Flask, GCP, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, AI agents, React, Next.js

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* **Range without job-hopping.** Startup speed one year, enterprise scale the next, same employer. Consulting life excites you, and you understand the value of communication.
* **A consultancy that sticks together.** Even when you're placed with a client, you're part of a team that meets up regularly, over lunch, after work and at hackathons. You're never just a name on a staffing list.
* **Room to grow.** A dedicated education budget and a clear path forward.
* **Flexibility when you need it.** Hybrid work in Stockholm, depending on what each client allows.

**Let's talk**
--------------


The client is confidential for now, so the full picture comes in a first, discreet conversation.


No cover letter needed. Send your CV or LinkedIn profile here If there's a GitHub repo or project you're proud of, include the link. Everything is handled confidentially.  

  

Note:


Our client does not provide visa sponsorship or relocation support.


Applicants must already have a permanent and independent right to work in Sweden and reside in the Stockholm area.

title: Ramavtalsförvaltare med inriktning mot it

title: Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform
description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.


**About COMSOL**
----------------


COMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.


**Role**
--------


Based in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.


In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.


You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.


The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.


Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.


**Qualifications**
------------------


For this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:


* M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
* Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
* Several years of professional software development experience.
* An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:


* Large software projects and mature codebases.
* Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
* Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
* Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
* Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
* Build and development automation.
* Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.


**Working at COMSOL**
---------------------


At COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.


New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.


We also offer:


* A competitive salary
* Individual pension plans
* Sponsored gym membership
* Work-life balance with regular working hours

To ensure a smooth onboarding process, onsite presence is required. Once onboarded, hybrid work options are available.


**To Apply**
------------


Does this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish Make sure to include:


* Cover letter
* CV
* University diploma with grades

Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.


To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.


For more information, contact Mikael Sterner at tel. 08-412 95 00.


We review applications continuously.



**Reference** REF-10051

**Location** Stockholm, Sweden

Här bidrar du till att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för elever att lyckas, oavsett var i landet de befinner sig.***


Uppsala Distans är en specialiserad verksamhet inom Palmbladsskolan som erbjuder distansundervisning som särskilt stöd för elever i årskurs 7-9. Vi arbetar för att skapa tillgängliga, flexibla och individanpassade lösningar för elever som av olika skäl inte kan delta i ordinarie undervisning.


Verksamheten omfattar totalt 90 elevplatser, varav 60 platser för elever från Uppsala kommuns skolor och 30 platser för interkommunala elever samt elever från fristående huvudmän. Vi samverkar dagligen med hemskolor, elevhälsoteam, vårdnadshavare och skolledningar runt om i landet för att säkerställa att varje elev får de bästa möjliga förutsättningarna att lyckas.

Nu går vi in i vårt tredje verksamhetsår med en stabil grund och höga ambitioner. Hos oss blir du en del av en engagerad och utvecklingsinriktad organisation där samarbete, professionalitet och elevens bästa står i centrum.


Arbetet som it-administratör med skoladministrativt ansvar sker på plats på Palmblads skolan

Som it-administratör ansvarar du för en bred variation av administrativa och samordnande uppgifter. Du är ofta i kontakt med vår personal och samverkande skolor och har en viktig roll i att säkerställa effektiva och professionella processer.

* stötta skolledning i strategiska och operativa frågor som rör IT-system.
  

  

I det administrativa uppdraget ingår bland annat:


* hantera inkommande telefonsamtal, e-post och andra förfrågningar.
* ansvara för elevadministration kopplad till inskrivning, placeringar och elevregister.
* hantering av elevers individuella scheman i Skola 24

* arbeta med personaladministration och lönerapportering.

* ge administrativt stöd till skolledning, elevhälsa och pedagogisk personal.
* medverka i utvecklingen av effektiva administrativa rutiner och arbetssätt.
* betygsättning

Du arbetar nära skolledningen och är en central funktion i verksamheten. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du till att skapa förutsättningar för lärare och elevhälsa att fokusera på sitt pedagogiska uppdrag samtidigt som elever och vårdnadshavare får ett professionellt och tryggt bemötande.


Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och ett nära samarbete med både interna och externa aktörer, vilket gör den varierad, utvecklande och betydelsefull för verksamhetens kvalitet.

Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar i en skolmiljö där arbetsuppgifter och prioriteringar kan variera från dag till dag. Du är serviceinriktad och bemöter elever, vårdnadshavare och medarbetare på ett professionellt, tillmötesgående och lösningsfokuserat sätt. Du har en god problemlösande analysförmåga och kan identifiera, analysera och hantera administrativa frågor och utmaningar på ett strukturerat och effektivt sätt. Vidare har du en god samarbetsförmåga och arbetar smidigt tillsammans med såväl skolledning som lärare och övrig personal för att bidra till en väl fungerande verksamhet.

title: Exmensarbete, 30 hp: Teknikstudie för implementation av optimerad design av motorstyrning ﻿
description:

### **Din roll**


Vi ser det enorma värdet som studenter tillför vårt företag. Din akademiska precision, i kombination med din entusiasm för avancerad teknik, gör att du kan närma dig problem med en unik och insiktsfull lins. På Saab får du möjlighet att samarbeta med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister, få ovärderlig praktisk erfarenhet och samtidigt bidra till vår tillväxt och utveckling

  

  

**Bakgrund**


Dynamics, ett affärsområde inom Saab, erbjuder understödsvapen, missiler, sensorer, obemannade farkoster, kamouflagesystem och träningssystem för försvarsmarknaden.

  

  

Elektronikavdelningen är en del av utvecklingsavdelningen inom affärsområdet Dynamics och består av cirka 150 medarbetare. Vi arbetar med elektronikutveckling från koncept till layout, test och verifiering.

  

  

**Beskrivning av examensarbetet**


Examensarbetet utgår från en befintlig produkt som ska kunna användas inom både flyg och fartyg. Examensarbetet syftar till att undersöka möjligheten att i framtida versioner av existerande produkt implementera denna typ av system för styrning av motorer.

  

  

Examensarbetet innebär en ny teknikstudie för SAAB med inriktning på en ny optimerad lösning för design av motorstyrning. Examensarbetet innebär en tekniskundersökning av hur man med GaN FET kan göra en optimerad design för motorstyrning. Examensarbetet kommer innebära komponentval samt val av olika tekniker för implementation och simulering av layout för att uppnå en design med eftersträvad karakteristik.

  

  

Studentens huvudsakliga uppgift blir att utföra en jämförelse av teoretiskt/simulerade lösningar står sig i jämförelse med mätningar på tillverkad hårdvara. En utvärdering av GaN FET för en optimerad lösning i avseende på inverkan på andra inkopplade enheter i ett system. Målet med examensarbete är att designa en lösning för 400V motorstyrning.

  

  

### **Din profil**


Vi söker 1-2 personer med intresse för elektronik samt inbyggda system, vilket innebär konstruktion av elektronik och programmering av programerbar logik. Lämplig utbildning är civilingenjör/magister med inriktning mot elektronik, teknisk fysik eller liknande.

* elektronikutveckling
* hårdvarunära programmering av FPGAer
* kravskrivning och dokumentation av elektronik
* signalbehandling
  

Vi ger dig det stöd och den vägledning du behöver för att omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiska lösningar. Bli en drivande kraft bakom Saabs tekniska framsteg!

  

  

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*

Peter Anderstedt
  

Peter.anderstedt@saabgroup.com
  

0734186153

Sofie Cicek

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

title: AI Workplace Lead
description:
AI är inte längre något vid sidan av jobbet. Det håller på att bli en del av hur jobbet faktiskt blir gjort. Vill du vara med och forma hur?


På Svenska Spel vill vi göra AI användbart för fler, i fler delar av vardagen. Därför söker vi nu en AI Workplace Lead som vill ta en central roll i hur vi väljer, utvecklar och använder AI i vår digitala arbetsplats.


Här får du jobba i skärningspunkten mellan AI, teknik och människor. Ena dagen utvärderar du en AI-plattform eller kravställer en ny agentlösning. Nästa dag hjälper du kollegor att förstå hur tekniken kan göra deras jobb enklare, smartare och bättre.


Kort sagt: du hjälper oss gå från *”AI kan nog göra det där”* till *”så här gör vi det säkert, smart och tillsammans”*.

**Vad kommer du att göra?**


Som AI Workplace Lead driver du vår medarbetarnära AI-förmåga framåt. Du håller ihop riktningen för våra gemensamma AI-verktyg, integrationer, assistenter, agenter och automationer och ser till att de skapar konkret nytta i vardagen.


Du kommer bland annat att:

* utvärdera och driva vägval kring AI-verktyg och plattformar som ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise och framtida lösningar
* utveckla roadmap och prioriteringar för AI i vår digitala arbetsplats
* initiera och kravställa integrationer, AI-assistenter, processagenter och automationer
* fånga upp behov från våra användare och omvandla dem till tekniska förbättringar och nya förmågor
* följa upp användning, kvalitet och användarupplevelse och hela tiden göra lösningarna lite bättre
* ta fram guider, utbildningar och demos som gör AI begripligt och användbart
* kommunicera kring lanseringar, förändringar och nya möjligheter
* jobba tätt tillsammans med bland andra IT Workplace, HR Tech, säkerhet, juridik, arkitektur, inköp, leverantörer och verksamheten.


Och eftersom AI-världen knappast står still kommer du också behöva navigera i förändring, göra kloka prioriteringar och veta när en fråga behöver landa hos någon annan.

**Är du den som kommer att göra det?**


Vi tror att du gillar kombinationen teknik + människor + förändring.


Du behöver förstå generativ AI på djupet för att kunna se skillnader mellan plattformar, fatta tekniska vägval och kravställa lösningar. Men minst lika viktigt är att du kan förklara *varför* ett vägval är rätt och få andra att vilja använda det som byggs.


Du är nyfiken på ny teknik, men springer inte på varje ny AI-boll bara för att den råkar studsa förbi. Säkerhet, dataskydd, användarupplevelse och faktisk nytta är minst lika viktiga som vad tekniken *kan* göra.


För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:

* erfarenhet av digital arbetsplats och klienthantering i en större organisation
* erfarenhet av att införa eller utveckla generativa AI-verktyg, assistenter, skills, agenter eller automationer
* erfarenhet av plattformar som Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft 365, Atlassian, ChatGPT Enterprise eller motsvarande
* erfarenhet av MCP och av att koppla samman plattformar med olika datakällor och connectorer
* erfarenhet av tekniska vägval, kravställning, roadmap och leverantörssamarbeten
* god förståelse för informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och ansvarsfull AI
* en riktigt bra pedagogisk och kommunikativ förmåga och gör komplex teknik begriplig för människor med olika förkunskaper.


Har du dessutom jobbat med agentplattformar, workflow-automation, API-integrationer, IAM eller low-code/no-code-lösningar blir vi extra nyfikna.


Vi ser gärna att du har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis IT, informatik eller systemvetenskap. Har du byggt motsvarande kunskap genom arbetslivet är det lika relevant.

**Om Tech på Svenska Spel**


På Svenska Spel hanterar vi 10 000 000 transaktioner varje dag, året runt och på sex dagar har vi hanterat samma transaktionsvolym som den största pengaöverföringsappen gör på en månad. Varje dag utvecklar, driftar och supportar vi ett av världens mest avancerade spelsystem, vi är med andra ord ett techbolag som sysslar med spel - inte tvärtom. Det här kommer med ett ansvar, både för folkets drömmar och spänning, men även för deras spelande. Vi flyttar ständigt fram gränserna för vår tech och låter aldrig vår Drömmaskin stå still. Kom och utveckla den med oss!

**Vi är Svenska Spel**


Svenska Spel är hela Sveriges spelbolag. Vi skapar hållbara och roliga spelupplevelser som bidrar till ett bättre Sverige. Genom spel som Triss, Stryktipset och Oddset ger vi våra fyra miljoner kunder spänning, glädje och drömmar. Våra spel är enkla och trygga och oavsett om man spelar online eller fysiskt, själv eller tillsammans med andra, så ska upplevelsen alltid vara positiv.
