Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Through our Mission Critical Communication hub, we are shaping the future of secure communications in Sweden. Anchored in Stockholm and bringing together some of the industry's leading experts, this hub supports organizations responsible for public safety, emergency response and critical infrastructure. Join us and help shape solutions that make a real difference where reliability, security, and resilience matter most.


**Your role**


We are currently strengthening our specialist team within mission-critical communications and telecom. We are looking for experienced consultants who want to help design the next generation of business-critical and operationally critical communication solutions.
  

  

Do you want to shape the future of OSS (Operations Support Systems)? We are looking for several specialists who want to contribute to the development of modern solutions for network operations, service management, analytics, and automation. We focus on creating visibility, control, and efficiency across complex network and service environments. This is where business, technology, and data come together to enable proactive operations, high service quality, and data-driven decision-making.
  

  

We are looking for professionals with expertise in architecture, business analysis, service assurance, data analytics, network operations, integration, and technical project management.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*  

  



* Developing OSS architectures and strategic solutions for networks and services
* Business analysis and requirements management for OSS-related processes and tools
* Performance Management, Fault Management, and log management
* Service Assurance, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and continuous improvement of operational processes
* Developing semantic models and data layers to improve network visibility and understanding
* Designing and implementing tools for NOCs (Network Operations Centers) and end-user organizations
* Integrating OSS platforms, operational tools, and business systems
* Leading implementations, technical deliveries, and transformation initiatives

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

*Vi söker fler engagerade kollegor till vårt Telesales-team som är en del av Internal Sales Channels och en av de största avdelningarna på Tre.* *Här arbetar vi med att ta hand om våra befintliga kunder, genom att förstå deras behov, skapa värde och erbjuda lösningar som gör det enkelt och smart att vara kund hos oss.*

**Om rollen**

Hos oss är Telesales mer än bara samtal. Det är en plats för att växa, bygga relationer och skapa kundupplevelser som sticker ut. I den här rollen arbetar du med utgående samtal till våra befintliga kunder. Du lyssnar in, guidar och hjälper kunden att hitta rätt lösning. Du får även möjlighet att ta emot inkommande samtal från kunder som är nyfikna på våra erbjudanden.

Du blir en del av ett team med stark sammanhållning, där våra Säljcoacher finns nära till hands för att stötta dig i din utveckling och hjälpa dig nå dina mål. Här firar vi framgångar tillsammans och peppar varandra att bli bättre varje dag. Vårt mål är att du ska nå dina mål!


**Vi erbjuder dig**

* Att vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place To Work och vi är stolta samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar.


**Några av våra medarbetare**
-----------------------------

Julia Maxén
Gruppchef
*"Jag vill att mitt team ska få de bästa förutsättningarna för att göra sitt jobb på bästa sätt. Det är så vi utvecklar oss som team, men även utvecklar Tre framåt."*

Digital projektledare
*"Det absolut bästa med att vara projektledare på Tre är jag får jobba brett med kollegor från alla delar av organisationen och få lära mig nya saker varje dag. Jag har friheten att vara mig själv – och bli uppskattad för det!"*
Jayasri Battola
Utvecklare
*"The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like Cloud and Azure."*
**Kvalifikationer**
-------------------

**Mer om dig**

Vi tror att du är någon som trivs med att ta kontakt, skapa dialog och bygga relation. Du har energi, ett tydligt driv och ser möjligheter där andra kanske tvekar. Du är modig i det du tar dig an, och tycker det känns motiverande att jobba mot tydligt uppsatta mål där du ser resultat av ditt arbete.



Har du tidigare erfarenhet av kundservice eller försäljning är det ett plus, men det är inte avgörande. För oss är det viktigare vem du är än vad du gjort tidigare, vi ser till att du får med dig all kunskap och de verktyg du behöver för att lyckas.


**Lite praktisk information**

* Arbetstiderna är måndag till fredag, 09.00–18.00 (fredagar till 17.00).
* Du behöver vara över 18 år och kunna prata och skriva obehindrat på svenska och engelska.
* Tjänsten är på heltid med start i höst.
* Vi arbetar från vårt fina 3hus vid Globenområdet, Stockholm.


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**



Låter det här som något för dig? Vad roligt, vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


Att söka jobbet är enkelt och går snabbt. Du behöver bara besvara några urvalsfrågor direkt i annonsen, inget personligt brev behövs. För att ge alla samma chans att visa sin potential använder vi tester som första steg i rekryteringsprocessen.


För våra slutkandidater genomför vi en bakgrundskontroll. Du får mer information om detta under rekryteringsprocessen.


Varmt välkommen till oss på Tre!

* Flexibla helgdagar och sex dagar extra ledigt per år
* Hundzon & gym i 3huset
* Subventionerad lunch
* Förmånliga rabatter på cyklar, kollektivtrafik och elbilar

----------------

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.



Tre föddes som utmanare och är en organisation i ständig rörelse. Vi strävar efter att vara i framkant i allt vi gör. Vi är övertygade om att det är människorna och kulturen på Tre som är avgörande för vår utveckling.



När du startar din resa på Tre finns det oändliga möjligheter att växa och utvecklas med oss.

**WE ACT LIKE BUDDIES** - På Tre är vi schyssta kollegor. Vi samarbetar med varandra över team och funktioner, vi bollar idéer, ger och tar emot feedback.

description:

Nu söker vi en System Engineer till vårt team där du tillsammans med dina nya kollegor erbjuder en fantastisk användarupplevelse med en verktygsflora som supporterar våra utvecklare under hela produktlivscykeln. Vi hoppas att du vill vara med oss och får möjlighet att göra skillnad!


**Det här gör du som System Engineer på Folksam**
-------------------------------------------------


Du ansvarar för att applikationer och plattformar ligger i linje med arkitekturell vision och roadmap och du säkerställer att teknik- och plattformsarbetet följer affärssatsningar. Tillsammans med dina kollegor i teamet strävar du efter att automatisera det som är möjligt och med ett högt fokus på IT-säkerhet. Vi är ett distribuerat team med medlemmar på flera orter så vi är vana att samarbeta effektivt via digitala kanaler. Vi jobbar nära andra utvecklingsteam på Folksam samt leverantörer. Det innebär att vi kommunicerar både på svenska och engelska dagligen.


Vi ansvarar för GitLab DevSecOps-plattform och JFrog Artifactory och relaterade funktioner som GitLab CI/CD, Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) och JFrog Xray för Software Composition Analysis (SCA) för on-premise, container-, moln- och hybridteknologistackar och applikationer. Vårt team ansvarar även för Anthropic Claude.


Vi som team stödjer 460 utvecklare och vi arbetar med Folksamgruppens mål om Infrastructure as Code (IaC) mot Azure Red Hat OpenShift och Cloud computing. Vi implementerar platform engineering utefter Folksamsgruppens agila styrmodell.


På Infrastruktur, Operation och IT-säkerhet är vi cirka 130 medarbetare. Tillsammans ansvara vi för Folksamgruppens verktyg och infrastrukturella tjänster. Vi inom Utvecklingsnära ansvarar för Folksamgruppens centrala utvecklingsverktyg.


**Är du den vi söker?**
-----------------------


Om du är den vi söker motiveras du av att arbeta med teknik, på djupet. Du kan snabbt anamma ny teknik samt har en bred teknisk kompetens som krävs för att kunna förstå våra befintliga landskap. Du är nyfiken och vill ständigt utvecklas och lära dig nytt. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du kan checka av flera av följande kompetenser. Vi behöver en bra mix i teamet så det är bara en fördel om vi har olika styrkor inom teamet som kompletterar varandra.


Detta kommer hjälpa dig att lyckas i rollen:


* Erfarenhet av moderna plattformar exempelvis Kubernetes/Azure Red Hat Openshift.
* Erfarenhet inom IT-automatisering och verktygsstöd som GitLab, JFrog Artifactory och Xray för CI/CD.
* Erfarenhet av versionshanterad infrastrukturkod (Terraform/Helm/Ansible, ArgoCD).
* Erfarenhet att arbeta med AI.
* Förståelse för monitoreringsstöd och logghantering av Elastic (ELK-Stack) - t.ex. uppsättning, livcykelhantering, tillgänglighet och prestanda på plattformen.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med DevSecOps och felsökning relaterad till ovan beskrivna ramverk.
* Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla robusta och säkra tekniska lösningar enligt regulatoriska krav.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta enligt agila metoder och verktyg.

Du visar mod och agerar utifrån din egen övertygelse samtidigt som du har förmågan att sätta dig in i andras perspektiv och ha det i beaktande. Din förmåga att entusiasmera andra i kombination med ditt självledarskap bidrar i allra högsta grad till din förmåga att få saker att hända. I kommunikation med andra är du rak och tydlig och du vet hur du ska förmedla ett budskap så att det är enkelt och lätt att förstå.

Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. title: Infrastructure & Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
### **A Snapshot of Your Day**

### 
Your day combines architecture, engineering and hands-on technical leadership. You may review a hybrid connectivity design in the morning, guide a project team through a security or integration decision and later troubleshoot a production-critical service with global specialists. You create robust, supportable solutions across cloud and on-premises environments and help stakeholders make clear technical decisions without losing sight of operational reliability, cybersecurity and business value.

### **How You'll make an Impact**

* Design and govern secure Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud solutions that support engineering, supplier-facing, and operational applications, ensuring scalability, resilience, compliance, and business continuity.
* Develop architecture standards and reference patterns for cloud-native applications, integrations, APIs, data services, and hybrid workloads across Azure and on-premises environments.
* Define secure connectivity, network, identity, and service communication architectures across Azure, enterprise platforms, external partner integrations, and business-critical systems.
* Lead cloud and infrastructure architecture reviews and provide technical direction for modernization, migration, integration, and technology lifecycle management initiatives.
* Partner with application teams to develop architecture roadmaps and guide the adoption of Azure-native services, automation, and modern cloud operating practices.
* Ensure reliable integration between Azure services, business applications, databases, and enterprise infrastructure, enabling secure, high-performing, and resilient business operations.
* Design solutions with high availability, disaster recovery, observability, and operational supportability as core architectural principles.
* Serve as a trusted technical leader and escalation point for complex technical challenges, collaborating across infrastructure, cybersecurity, development, engineering, and business functions.

### **What you bring**

* Proven experience in Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure Architecture, Cloud Architecture, Solution Design or senior infrastructure engineering roles preferably from a global environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure and secure hybrid connectivity patterns.
* Deep understanding of enterprise networking, firewalls, Active Directory, Domain Name System, compute, storage and infrastructure security.
* Experience with PKI environments, digital certificates, identity and access management, and business-critical infrastructure services throughout their operational lifecycle.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to explain complex technical choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Professional English communication skills, Swedish, experience with manufacturing systems, operational technology, Oracle or SQL environments and infrastructure automation is advantageous.

 **About the Team**  


You will work within Digital Manufacturing & Operations alongside factory IT teams, cloud and infrastructure specialists, cybersecurity colleagues, application owners and external partners. The team delivers resilient and secure technology foundations for critical manufacturing and business services.  

Our **Gas Services division** offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.  

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo **Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. **Application**
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en\_US/jobs , id nr 303946 not later than 2026-10-21.
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.

title: Data Center Engineering Technician, DCEO
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  

  

We are currently seeking a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician to serve as a technical resource within our mission critical Data Center’s. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels of Data Center Engineering Operations. We strive towards building a diverse workforce and look to hire the best people we can regardless of age, gender or ethnicity.  

  

Due to the success of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) operations and rapid expansion of Data Centers we are recruiting suitable candidates to operate/maintain these facilities in Sweden. In this role you will have a positive involvement in both the maintenance of facilities and the improvement of efficiencies to help offer Amazon customer’s better value.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will also be involved in:  

o Assisting in the operation and maintenance of all electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety equipment and HVAC equipment within the Data Center/Facility. This equipment supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.  

o Assisting in the maintenance and monitoring of all Data Center systems to include incidents/events, problems, changes, monitoring, problem escalation/notification/resolution and all other aspects of Data Center support.  

o Monitoring and troubleshooting all mechanical, electrical, HVAC systems, voice/data, cooling systems, fire/life safety equipment and generators.  

o Providing assistance to contractor or data center engineers to ensure proper operation and maintenance of all facility equipment.  

o Providing assistance to contractors or data center engineers to deploy new equipment, such as building racks, cabling, and other tasks as necessary.  

o Performing site walk throughs to verify proper operation of Facility Equipment and Monitoring Systems.  

  

In addition to acting as a Facilities First Responder to critical events, you will be a part of the team supporting new data center facilities and existing data center facilities!  

  

A day in the life  

Day to day activities for this role include;
  

o Monitoring of all alarms and systems involved in the operation of power, cooling and fire suppression systems in the data center.
  

o Planning and coordinating vendor works on site to ensure equipment is maintained and uptime retained.
  

o Supporting other sites and teams during events and planned works.
  

o Carrying out rack power up and installation duties.
  

o Monitoring and facilitating new equipment handover.
  

o Supporting new hires and team members through knowledge share and development.
  

o Event response and drill participation.  

  

  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship & Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Electrical, mechanical or instrumentation training and/or relevant experience
* 2+ years of relevant work experience
* Strong English verbal and written communication skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in data center engineering

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: RAN Feature Verification Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

 **About this opportunity**  

At Ericsson, we are shaping the future of connectivity. Through our NextGen Program, we are looking for curious, ambitious and analytical engineers who want to build their careers by working on technologies that connect billions of people worldwide.

  

As a RAN Feature Verification Engineer, you will join a collaborative team working with Ericsson's Baseband software for 5G and future 6G Radio Access Networks (RAN). You will contribute to the quality, integration and reliability of software that powers modern mobile networks. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with software testing, integration, troubleshooting and test automation while working alongside experienced engineers. You will learn how complex real-time systems and telecom products work and develop your skills in a global R&D environment.

  

We are looking for people with strong potential and a genuine interest in testing and software quality. You do not need to be an expert in telecom or 5G/6G - we will support you in developing this knowledge on the job.

 **About our organization**  

Our organization, Product Engineering Group 3 (PEG 3), is part of Product Engineering Unit RAN Performance (PEU RP), which is responsible for Ericsson's Baseband software for the Purpose-built and Cloud RAN portfolio in 5G and 6G.

  

The FV test team works with Integration and Verification end to end on real and simulated Hardware. But are also developing test automation testcases.  

By joining us, you will have the opportunity to work with technologies that are shaping the future of mobile communications while developing your technical skills and building a strong foundation for your career.

 **What you will do**  

As a RAN Feature Verification Engineer, you will:

* Develop (integrate and test) 5G and 6G baseband architecture, functionality and features in an end-to-end as well as in a partly simulated environment.
* Write inventive, high quality, clean, optimized test code for use in verification and continuous integration.
* Maintain and improve the quality of L1 and L2 part of the Baseband product by securing legacy coverage in test loops.
* Perform trouble shooting and customer support.
* Drive continuous improvements of products, environments and processes.
* Make sure that the right test environment is available in time, both the actual system test plant and the test environment with tools and automation frameworks.
* Analyze new requirements from new features.
* Be part of our AI transformation journey.

 **The skills you bring**  

Your personal qualities are important for us and we believe that you are productive, creative and that you interact easily with other people. In addition, you can plan and drive your own work to reach common goals together with your team. You are also able to adapt and respond quickly to change. Furthermore, you are positively set and strive to meet and exceed our customers’ expectations.


In addition, we believe you have:  

* Interest in and drive to learn software test and integration.
* BSc level (MSc preferred) in a technical field or the equivalent level of knowledge.
* Programming/scripting skills (Java, Python, Erlang).
* Multi-core processor understanding.
* Basic Real time embedded systems knowledge.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and coding assistants (for example Coding Buddy, GitHub Copilot or similar tools).
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  

The following are considered an advantage, but can also be developed on the job:  

* Knowledge of mobile networks, 4G/5G or 6G.
* Experience with software test automation.
* Knowledge of Baseband or Radio Access Network technologies.
* Familiarity with CI/CD or modern software development and testing practices.
  

If you are curious about how complex software systems work, enjoy solving problems and want to develop your career within one of the world's leading telecommunications technology companies in software testing and telecommunications, we would like to hear from you.

 **Why join Ericsson?**


At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.  

  

**What happens once you apply?**


Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

description:

 A specialist in identity, secure transactions, and digital services, IN Groupe is the global leader in secure identity and trust services. Every day, our 4,000 employees across 40 countries work to ensure that everyone has access to a reliable and secure identity, both in the physical and digital worlds. With our solutions and our international network of 10 R&D centers, we support governments and businesses in more than 130 countries.
   

  

 Joining IN Groupe means helping to shape the future of the identity and secure transaction market. Become part of our international teams — driven by innovation and proud to design solutions that make life easier and protect personal data for millions of people around the world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior backend engineer to join our Stockholm office** 
 with strong,
 **hands‑on expertise in modern Java,** 
 experienced in building and maintaining distributed systems and microservices. Brings solid proficiency in CI/CD and
 **Azure DevOps** 
 (or comparable platforms), along with practical knowledge of cloud environments, containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, automated testing practices, and operating services reliably in production.

title: Data Engineer
description:
*Vill du vara med och framtidssäkra ett av ATG:s viktigaste områden genom att bygga nästa generations Data Warehouse i molnet? Trivs du i en tekniskt avancerad miljö där datamodellering, kvalitet och skalbarhet står i fokus? Då kan rollen vara rätt för dig. Hos oss blir du en nyckelperson i transformationen från vårt befintliga Oracle on‑prem Data Warehouse till en modern molnbaserad lösning i Snowflake och AWS.* 




  





**I rollen får du:** 



* Vidareutveckla Data Warehouse i Snowflake och AWS
* Arbeta med datamodellering, transformationer och robusta dataflöden
* Bygga och optimera ETL/ELT‑processer
* Delta i förflyttningen från Oracle till Snowflake
* Integrera datakällor och möjliggöra nya dataflöden och use cases
* Bidra till principer för datamodellering och governance
* Påverka tekniska beslut och teamets arbetssätt



  





 Som Data Engineer inom Data Warehouse hos ATG blir du en nyckelperson i moderniseringen av vårt centrala Data Warehouse. Plattformen är central för ATG:S datadrivna arbete och används för analys, rapportering och beslutsstöd i hela organisation. Du kommer in i en fas där vi migrerar från Oracle on-prem till Snowflake i AWS och nu fortsätter bygga en modern, skalbar och framtidssäkrad lösning i molnet. Rollen ger stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka teknik, arkitektur och arbetssätt. Du arbetar i ett engagerat team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig utveckling är en naturlig del av vardagen.
 



  





**Är det här du?** 




 Vi söker dig som tycker att data engineering är som mest spännande när tekniken gör verklig nytta. Du är trygg i SQL och datamodellering, gillar att bygga hållbara och kvalitetssäkrade lösningar och har ett genuint intresse för hur data kan struktureras och görs tillgänglig effektivt. Du trivs med ansvar, nära samarbete och att bidra till både teknik och arbetssätt. Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och nyfiken, med förståelse för kvalitet och stabilitet i affärskritiska miljöer.
 



  





 Vi ser att du har:
 


* Erfarenhet av Data Engineering/Data Warehouse
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och datamodellering
* Erfarenhet av ETL/ELT-flöden
* Erfarenhet av Snowflake eller moderna cloud-DW
* Erfarenhet av AWS eller annan molnplattform
* Vana av Git och moderna utvecklingsflöden
* Förståelse för datakvalitet, prestandaoptimering och automatiserade tester
* God kommunikativ förmåga på engelska (svenska meriterande)
* Ett pragmatiskt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt i samarbete med andra team



 Meriterande:
 


* Data Vault eller andra modelleringsmetoder
* dbt eller liknande transformationsverktyg
* Orchestration-verktyg som Airflow eller motsvarande
* Python eller annat språk för data engineering
* Erfarenhet av affärskritiska miljöer med höga krav på stabilitet och tillgänglighet



  





 Som person är du prestigelös, driven och samarbetsorienterad och bidrar till en lärande kultur i teamet.
 



  





**”Jag tror på att människor utvecklas bäst när de känner trygghet, får förtroende och har möjlighet att påverka.”** 




 Jag har arbetat i flera roller inom IT – utvecklare, produktägare och scrum master – vilket gett mig en bred förståelse för både tekniken och människorna bakom leveransen. Idag drivs jag av att stötta individer och team i deras utveckling och skapa en miljö där vi lär av varandra och bygger hållbara lösningar. Det som gör rollen extra spännande är vår pågående transformation till ett modernt Data Warehouse i Snowflake och AWS, där du får stor möjlighet att påverka teknik och arbetssätt. När jag inte jobbar tycker jag om att resa och upptäcka nya platser – något som ger energi och nya perspektiv.
 



**Therese Göransson, Manager IT - DW, Financial & EWS** 




  





**We are the game** 




 I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Hos oss är du en del av en innovativ miljö – med hjälp av den senaste tekniken utvecklar vi spelupplevelser i världsklass. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Sedan starten 1974 har vi byggt och förvaltat systemen för våra produkter som hanterar 4 500 000 transaktioner per dag.
 



  





**Join the game!** 




 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

title: Data Migration Engineer
description:
**Data Migration Engineer – ADMS Series 6**
 Göteborg/Malmø, Sweden
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Migration Engineer, you will make an impact by supporting one of the most significant ADMS Series 6 transformation programs in Europe. You will be a valued member of our Energy & Utilities Technology team and work collaboratively with ADMS specialists, utility stakeholders, data architects, and integration teams to migrate and consolidate critical utility network data into a unified ADMS Series 6 environment.
   

  

 This role is part of a major grid modernization initiative involving the consolidation of multiple utility systems into a single operational platform. Whether you are an early-career engineer with experience in data migration and ETL development or a seasoned professional with utility industry expertise, this is an opportunity to work on technology that supports safe, reliable, and efficient grid operations.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Execute data migration activities from multiple source systems into a consolidated ADMS Series 6 environment.
* Design, develop, and maintain ETL processes and migration pipelines to support large-scale utility data transformations.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful delivery of migration milestones and project objectives.
* Validate, cleanse, and reconcile complex utility network data to maintain high levels of integrity, quality, and accuracy.
* Analyze source data structures and identify opportunities to improve migration efficiency and data quality.
* Support migration testing, defect resolution, validation activities, and deployment readiness assessments.
* Collaborate with utility stakeholders, ADMS engineers, and integration teams to resolve technical data challenges.
* Contribute to migration documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable utility data standards and operational requirements.


**Work Model**
 We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
   

  

 1The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.2
   

  

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**
* 1-6+ years of experience in data migration, ETL development, data engineering, GIS systems, utility technologies, or related technical disciplines.
* Hands-on experience with data migration projects involving large or complex datasets.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Understanding of SCADA systems, electrical networks, GIS platforms, or utility operational technologies.
* Experience developing or supporting ETL processes and data transformation workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot data quality and integration issues.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in hybrid, distributed teams.
* Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced project environment.


**These Will Help You Stand Out**
* Experience with ADMS, SCADA, EMS, or DMS platforms.
* Knowledge of IEC 61970/61968 Common Information Model (CIM) standards.
* Experience with Python scripting for automation, transformation, or validation activities.
* Familiarity with Windows and Linux environments.
* Understanding of utility integration standards and utility network models.
* Experience with GIS technologies used in electric utility environments.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Background in utilities, energy management, smart grid technologies, or critical infrastructure environments.


 We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Data Engineer Consultant - Bloom 27
description:
**Who are we looking for?**
 We are looking for exceptionally talented students with a strong interest in data and analytics. We believe that you’re a curious problem solver with sharp analytical skills and a collaborative mindset. You find coding intrinsically rewarding and you likely have experience with a few programming languages and AI programming tools like Claude Code. You’re interested in learning more about cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP. Maybe your hobby is collecting and analyzing large datasets then extract interesting insights from them using different tools and perspectives.
   

  

**Role**
 You probably hold or are pursuing a master’s degree in computer science/engineering/information systems and/or economics/statistics from a university in Sweden or abroad. To be successful in your role, you possess:
   

  

* Strong analytical skills
* Proven capability to learn new technologies
* Interest in identifying real business problems
* Ambition and drive
* Collaboration and communication skills
* Fluent verbal and written communication skills in Swedish & English


**What can you expect?**
 You will gain hands-on experience and the training required to become a successful data engineering consultant in the data and analytics field. We offer a steep learning curve in a fast-paced and fun environment.
   

  

 You will be employed by Adage, which will give you a specialization within data and analytics. At the same time, you’ll build a broad and solid foundation in general management consulting through the Bloom program. You will work alongside other participants across the Newground Alliance, with regular opportunities to share and discuss experiences and ideas along the way.
   

  

 For you in the beginning of your career, we at Adage, together with our Alliance companies, offer:
   

  

* Involvement from day one in business development discussions and strategic planning
* A solid training package in core consulting skills, including project management and BI tools
* Experience-based training with exciting projects, where you get the opportunity to take initiative and add value to our clients
* A mentor, who is one of the best and most experienced consultants in the business, to support you in your development


 At Adage, we invest in your growth for as long and as far as your abilities, enthusiasm, and dedication take you. Our belief is that if you start as a promising tech-savvy consultant, you will become a full-fledged data and analytics expert with a solid foundation in consulting.
   

  

 We are ready to help you bloom.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 Adage is not just another tech consultancy – we're a highly specialized movement dedicated to improving businesses through the power of data and analytics. We are about the results, not the hype.
   

  

 Our end-to-end offering helps companies unlock the full potential of their data. From defining a data strategy and setting up and realizing an analytics organization to selecting and implementing the needed data platforms.
   

  

 As a small consultancy company, we offer a close-knit team environment where your contributions have a direct impact. Here, your ideas are heard and valued, and you'll have the chance to shape the direction of the company. If you’re looking for a place to make a real difference and grow alongside the company, this is the place for you!
   

  

 At Adage, we are good at what we do, have a recipe for success and are honest in our intentions. We like to keep things simple. You will meet a warm and ambitious team that’s serious about making an impact while keeping things fun.
   

  

 To read more about who we are and what we do, visit Adage
   

  

**About Bloom**
 You will be employed by Adage while participating in the Bloom graduate consultancy training program alongside colleagues from other companies within Newground Alliance. Bloom is a unique, people-centric learning journey providing young consultants with everything they need to begin a successful career.
   

  

 Instead of classroom learning, Bloom is a true consulting apprenticeship. From day one, you’ll work on real projects with real clients. You’ll learn your craft alongside some of the best, most experienced consultants in the business – and get the chance to make suggestions, shake things up and forge your own career path.
   

  

 With regular opportunities to share experiences and discuss ideas with colleagues across Newground Alliance, Bloom is more than just a first job: it’s a broad and solid foundation for a consulting career in any sector. And it’s a chance to work and grow in an environment where you can bloom and keep on blooming. As far as your talent will take you.
   

  

 The Bloom program will start in August 2027.
   

  

**The recruitment process**
* Application
* Online personality and logic test
* First interview
* Technical case presentation and interview with hiring manager
* Offer


 Our selection process has started and the last day to apply is  31st of October. Please submit your application today since selection is done continuously.
   

  

 #Adage
   

  

 Newground began with a simple belief. Experienced consultants should be able to build firms around true specialization, without choosing between focus and scale.
   

  

 In 2014, four management consultants shaped the ideas for building something different. Drawing on their experience building consultancies, their ambition was to create an environment where the principles of consulting done right could take shape, guided by deep expertise, long-term relationships, and professional pride.
   

  

 From the outset, the goal was not to build a single firm. The founders believed the strongest companies are built around clear niches and entrepreneurial teams. Instead of consolidating into one organization, they created a structure where specialist firms remain autonomous while benefiting from shared infrastructure, long-term capital, and aligned ownership, with expertise close to decisions and clear accountability across the alliance.

title: Senior Investigator
description:
At Accenture, you can bring your innovative vision to the heart of change to transform entire market sectors. Shape the future of business and technology by developing cutting-edge solutions that create new value.
   

  

 Your role and opportunities
   

  

 Join our international network of talents in the Incident Response field. You will work with innovative technologies on exciting projects, developing solutions to manage data securely. Specifically, you will be able to:
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

  

- Perform incident response to cybersecurity incidents, including but not limited to APT & Nation State attacks, Ransomware infections and Malware outbreaks, Insider Threats, BEC, DDOS, Security and Data breach, etc.

- Conduct in-depth investigations of cybersecurity incidents, identifying the root cause, the extent of the impact, and recommended actions for containment, eradication, and recovery, and providing a final report that contains recommendations on how to prevent the same attack in the future by strengthening security posture.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information, coordinate incident response efforts, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders, including management and legal teams.

- Perform digital forensics examinations on various digital devices (workstations, servers, mobile devices, etc.) to collect, analyze, and preserve evidence related to security incidents or policy violations.

- Develop/Update incident response plan, playbooks, process, and process documentation to ensure standardized incident response procedures.

- Participate in threat hunting activities, proactively seeking out and identifying potential security threats and weaknesses.

- Assist in implementing and fine-tuning security tools and technologies to enhance threat detection and incident response capabilities.

- Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate employees on cybersecurity best practices and incident response procedures.

- Work closely with the Nordic clients to ensure quality relationships.

 If you share our passion for cybersecurity and have the following characteristics, we are looking forward to meeting you:
   

  

  

- Knowledge of file and memory forensics techniques and commonly used tools such as EnCase, Axiom, Autopsy, Kape, Plaso, Volatility, and FTK Suite.

- Good command of incident management and response processes and procedures.

- In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, EDR and SIEM tools, including Crowdstrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, TrendMicro VisionOne, and Splunk.

- Experience in conducting static or dynamic malware analysis, using solutions such as IDA Pro, OllyDbg, REMnux distro, and other disassemblers/debuggers.

- Detailed knowledge of Windows and Unix-based operating systems and administrative tools.

- Proficiency in English & Swedish.

- Ability to pass Security Clearances in Sweden

- Familiarity with disk and memory forensic analysis (Windows, Unix, or Linux environments).

- Knowledge of security controls such as authentication and identity management, network architectures enhanced for security, and application-based controls (including Windows, Unix, and network equipment).

- Proficiency in network traffic analysis and protocols using tools such as Wireshark.

- Interest to work closely with the clients, building relationships.

 Please expect slower feedback on your application due to summer vacation period, until August 11.

title: Director, Product Manager, Threat Protection & IP Intelligence
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Product Manager, Threat Protection & IP Intelligence
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard Security Solutions organization is seeking a Product Manager to lead Mastercard Threat Protection and IP Intelligence product portfolio. Threat Protection provides cloud-based network and application security capabilities designed to help customers and partners defend against DDoS attacks, malicious internet traffic, bots, and application-layer threats. IP Intelligence extends the value of the underlying threat data by enabling customers to incorporate continuously updated intelligence on malicious IP addresses into their existing security environments and controls.
   

  

 The Product Manager will be accountable for the business and product performance of the portfolio, including product strategy, commercialization, roadmap prioritization, go-to-market execution, customer and partner engagement, and P&L management. The role will work across technology, operations, sales, finance, marketing, legal, compliance, and regional teams to translate market opportunities and customer needs into scalable solutions and measurable commercial outcomes.
   

  

 This is a highly visible role for a commercially oriented product leader who can connect cybersecurity expertise, customer insight, technical execution, and financial discipline to grow the business.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Own the end-to-end product strategy for Mastercard Threat Protection and IP Intelligence, establishing clear product priorities, target customer segments, differentiated value propositions, and measurable business outcomes.
* Assume accountability for the portfolio P&L, including revenue performance, expense management, forecasting, budgeting, pricing, investment planning, and delivery against financial targets. Monitor product performance, identify variances and risks, and develop actions to improve revenue growth, profitability, and operating efficiency.
* Develop and maintain a commercially grounded product strategy informed by customer needs, partner feedback, threat landscape developments, competitive intelligence, technology trends, and Mastercard’s broader cybersecurity priorities.
* Define and prioritize the product roadmap in partnership with engineering and technical product teams.
* Lead the commercialization of Threat Protection and IP Intelligence, including proposition development, packaging, pricing, licensing, channel strategy, sales enablement, launch planning, and go-to-market execution.
* Partner with sales and regional teams to build and convert pipeline, support strategic opportunities, address barriers to adoption, and ensure that market feedback informs product and commercial decisions.
* Strengthen the partner proposition for managed security service providers, telecommunications companies, hosting providers, resellers, and other channel partners.
* Engage directly with customers and partners to understand their security, operational, and commercial needs, validate product direction, support critical engagements, and identify opportunities for retention, expansion, cross-sell, and new product development.
* Develop business cases for new capabilities and investments, articulating the customer need, strategic rationale, market opportunity, expected financial impact, delivery requirements, risks, and anticipated return.
* Work closely with engineering, architecture, security, operations, and support teams to translate market and customer requirements into clear product outcomes, while ensuring that delivered capabilities meet defined acceptance, reliability, scalability, and usability expectations.
* Collaborate with finance to maintain accurate forecasts and performance reporting, evaluate commercial scenarios, monitor product economics, and support investment and pricing decisions.
* Coordinate with marketing, communications, and sales enablement teams to develop clear positioning, value propositions, customer-facing materials, competitive guidance, and internal training.
* Represent the portfolio in product reviews, business performance discussions, customer meetings, partner engagements, sales forums, and senior leadership updates, communicating progress, risks, trade-offs, and recommended decisions with clarity.
* Build effective relationships across Mastercard and relevant affiliated businesses, identifying opportunities to connect Threat Protection and IP Intelligence with complementary capabilities and create stronger combined customer propositions.


**All About You**
* Proven product management experience, with a track record of managing cybersecurity, network security, cloud security, or enterprise technology products throughout their lifecycle.
* Demonstrated commercial ownership and experience managing a product as a business, including revenue targets, operating expenses, forecasting, budgeting, pricing, margins, investment cases, and overall P&L performance.
* Experience in B2B product commercialization, including market segmentation, value proposition development, packaging, pricing, channel strategy, product launches, sales enablement, pipeline development, and customer adoption.
* Experience working with direct sales teams and partner-led business models
* Exposure to managed security service providers, telecommunication companies, hosting providers, technology partners, resellers, or distributors would be advantageous.
* Strong customer orientation and confidence engaging with security leaders, technical practitioners, commercial stakeholders, partners, and senior executives.
* Demonstrated ability to identify underlying business requirements and translate customer and market feedback into actionable product and commercial priorities.
* Proven ability to develop compelling business cases that clearly articulate customer needs, strategic rationale, market opportunity, investment requirements, financial impact, delivery considerations, and expected returns.
* Strong understanding of the cybersecurity market, with practical knowledge in one or more areas such as DDoS protection, web application security, bot management, IP intelligence, cyber threat intelligence, security operations, or network and application infrastructure.
* Demonstrated effectiveness in complex, global, and matrixed organizations, including the ability to influence without direct authority, align stakeholders with competing priorities, manage ambiguity, and build trusted cross-functional relationships.
* A strong sense of ownership, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through, with a proactive approach to identifying issues, recommending solutions, managing risks, and remaining accountable for outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent the product confidently with customers, partners, sales teams, technical teams, finance stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in business, technology, cybersecurity, engineering, economics, or a related discipline. Relevant postgraduate qualifications or recognized certifications in product management, cybersecurity, or finance would be advantageous.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
⚡️
 **What We Do**
 Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing.
   

  

 Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.
   

  

 🌟
 **Who We Are**
 Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.
   

  

 At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.
   

  

 To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a systems-minded, technically grounded Senior Product Manager to own our trading platform.
   

  

 👩‍💻
 **The opportunity**
 We're hiring a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to own our Trading Platform. This is a platform role, not a trading one. Our optimizer decides what our assets should do across markets; the trading platform makes it happen – running our market integrations, submitting bids and schedules, dispatching through our own and third-party control systems, handling deviations, and proving what was actually delivered, all the way through settlement.
   

  

 As Flower grows across markets and asset types, the systems, counterparties, and market rules the platform works with keep multiplying. This isn't integration plumbing. It's designing how decisions and information flow through a system with more parties in it every year – and turning that diversity into one scalable product rather than a collection of one-off solutions. The trading platform wins by reach and reliability.
   

  

 The product is getting its first dedicated product manager. You'd be part of our product and market intelligence organization, working cross-functionally with engineering and trading, and an important interface toward our commercial teams and partners.
   

  

 We use a Shape Up-inspired methodology – fixed cycles, cool-down weeks, co-shaped pitches with defined appetite. We chose this because you can't build a world-class trading platform by spreading effort across everything at once.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the product. Direction, roadmap, and objectives for the trading platform – accountable for whether it delivers, not for how many features ship.
* Shape product bets. Find the highest-leverage problems, frame them clearly, and define what a good solution looks like – then leave room for the team to figure out how.
* Treat interfaces as the product. Well-designed boundaries are what let the platform take on new markets, systems, and partners quickly and reliably. You own them and hold their quality bar.
* Sequence expansion deliberately. New markets, integrations, and counterparty types – you decide what we take on, in what order, and what we decline, and make those trade-offs legible across the business.
* Work the external ecosystem. Drive build-vs-buy decisions, select the vendors we build on, and make things work with systems our partners have already chosen – accountable for the outcome without controlling both sides.
* Bring commercial context to technical decisions. Integration commitments show up in customer timelines and partner trust. Spend real time with the teams that depend on the platform.


**What You Won't Do**
 Manage a team. Groom a backlog. Spend your days in status meetings. We use Linear, Shape Up, and docs over tickets.
   

  

**Who You Are**
*We're not looking for a particular background. We're looking for a particular way of thinking.*
* 5+ years in product roles, with at least some of that time at companies where product management is taken seriously as a discipline.
* A systems thinker in the full sense. Clean interfaces matter, but the craft is deciding how systems should communicate: where a decision belongs in the stack, what information flows where, and what each layer needs to know.
* You see the general case behind the specific request. When five integrations each need something slightly different, you look for the one design that serves them all – and you know when to ship the simple thing instead.
* You're motivated by leverage, not spotlight. Platform work pays off in what other teams can suddenly do, often quarters later. You know how to build your own evidence that it's working, and that kind of impact satisfies you.
* You find reliability genuinely interesting. Failure modes, deviation handling, proving what actually happened – here, these are the product, and you'd rather own them than abstract them away.
* You can hold a boundary under commercial pressure. You've said no – or "yes, but like this" – to requests with revenue attached, and kept the relationship intact.
* You can hold your own in technical discussions – reading an interface contract, reasoning about what belongs on each side of a boundary. Your users here are often other systems, so this matters more than in most product roles.
* Intellectually curious. Energy markets are deep, complex, and full of structural shifts. You'll need to learn this domain, and you're excited by that.
* You use AI tools to go deeper and move faster – whether that's exploring data, testing ideas, or getting into territory that used to require a specialist.
* Fluent in English. Clear and precise in writing and speaking.


**You'll recognize yourself in some of this…**
* You've built platform, API, or integration-heavy products – where your customers included both internal teams and external parties, and the interface was the product.
* You've worked in energy, payments, market infrastructure, or another domain where correctness is existential and someone audits what you executed.
* You've worked with external vendors and partner-chosen systems – including evaluating what to build versus buy, and delivering outcomes through integrations where you only controlled one side.
* You've taken something from one bespoke implementation to a standardized many – and have opinions about when that transition should happen.
* You have experience with Shape Up, or a strong opinion on why most agile processes create more overhead than value.


**This probably isn't your role if…**
* Your energy comes from user-facing discovery, visual craft, or rapid experimentation loops. (Genuinely great skills – just not what this product rewards.)
* You need your impact to be directly attributable to feel real.


 📍
 **Location**
 Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.
   

  

 ✉️
 **Apply**
 Our corporate language is English, as we have about 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.
   

  

 During the recruitment process, you'll meet with the Talent Partner, the Hiring Manager, and members of the Product and Engineering teams. We'll ask you to think through real problems with us.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

*We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.*

title: It-operatör och informationshanterare säkra rymdtjänster
company: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency
description:
Myndigheten för civilt försvar
   

  

*Myndigheten för civilt försvar är den ledande, inriktande och samordnande myndigheten i det civila försvaret. Vi säkerställer att samhället är förberett för kris, höjd beredskap och krig.*
 Vill du vara med och leda utvecklingen av rymdrelaterade förmågor i det civila försvaret? Då kan du vara vår nästa kollega.
   

  

 Rymden har blivit en integrerad del av vår viktiga infrastruktur. Tjänster för navigering, kommunikation och meteorologi är i dag beroende av satellitsystem, samtidigt som rymden har utvecklats till en strategisk arena där hotbilden snabbt förändras. Att värna Sveriges säkerhet och samhällsfunktioner kräver därför ett helhetsperspektiv, där förmågan att förstå, skydda och använda rymden blir en allt mer central del av totalförsvaret.
   

  

**Ditt ansvar och dina arbetsuppgifter**
 Som it-operatör och informationshanterare arbetar du med att hantera och säkerställa informationsflöden i verksamhetens it-system. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat informationsöverföring, informationshantering och tillhörande administration i en verksamhet där höga krav ställs på konfidentialitet, riktighet och tillgänglighet. Du bidrar till att säkerställa att information är korrekt hanterad, tillgänglig för behöriga användare och dokumenterad på ett ändamålsenligt sätt.
   

  

 Befattningen kombinerar operativt systemarbete med informationshantering och innebär även att medverka i utvecklingen av rutiner, instruktioner och arbetssätt inom informationshantering och systemnära verksamhet.
   

  

**I Dina Arbetsuppgifter Ingår Bland Annat Att**
* identifiera, analysera och hantera enklare tekniska avvikelser som påverkar informationsflöden eller systemfunktioner.
* genomföra grundläggande felsökning i främst Linuxbaserade miljöer samt i viss omfattning Windowsmiljöer.
* delta i övningar, beredskapsarbete och incidenthantering.
* ge praktiskt stöd till verksamheten i frågor som rör informationshantering och systemanvändning.


 Deltagande i övningar, beredskapsarbete och incidenthantering kan ingå i befattningen.
   

  

**Dina kunskaper och kompetenser**
 Vi söker dig som har en relevant utbildning eller annan erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig, och erfarenhet av administrativt, tekniskt eller operativt arbete där noggrannhet, kvalitet och regelefterlevnad varit centrala delar av arbetet. Du har en förmåga att hantera information i it-system samt genomföra grundläggande felsökning i Linux- och Windowsmiljöer, och även en god förmåga att uttrycka sig på svenska i tal och skrift samt god förmåga att använda engelska i arbetsrelaterade kontakter.
   

  

**Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har Erfarenhet Av**
* sambands- och signalskyddstjänst eller annan närliggande verksamhet.
* operativt arbete i ledningssystem, it-drift, systemövervakning eller teknisk support.
* arbete med säkerhetsskyddsklassificerade uppgifter eller annan skyddsvärd information.
* dokument-, informations- eller registraturhantering.
* arbete i statlig verksamhet, Försvarsmakten eller annan verksamhet inom totalförsvaret.


 I allt vårt arbete, både internt och externt, ska vi agera utifrån den statliga värdegrunden. Som alla medarbetare och ledare hos oss förväntas du agera utifrån myndighetens förhållningssätt.
   

  

 Förhållningssätten gäller i vardag, kris och krig. De ska ses som en helhet och bygger på varandra; samarbetsinriktad – proaktiv - handlingskraftig.
   

  

 Läs mer om våra förhållningssätt
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten samt ha ett strukturerat arbetssätt. Du arbetar metodiskt, följer fastställda rutiner och uppmärksammar avvikelser när de uppstår. Du har intresse för teknik och systemstöd samt förmåga att metodiskt analysera och hantera problem i it-miljöer och informationsflöden.
   

  

 Rollen innebär många kontakter inom verksamheten och ställer därför krav på god samarbetsförmåga och ett serviceinriktat förhållningssätt. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper
   

  

**Om anställningen**
 Vi erbjuder dig en anställning tillsvidare på heltid som inleds med en provanställning. Din placeringsort kommer att vara Stockholm på vårt kontor Tomteboda, och resor i anställningen förekommer.
   

  

 Majoriteten av våra anställningar innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Vid placering i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. De flesta medarbetare på Myndigheten för civilt försvar är krigsplacerade. Att vara krigsplacerad innebär att du är ianspråktagen för att tjänstgöra vid höjd beredskap och krig.
   

  

**Om oss**
 Sektionen för rymdsäkerhet har i uppgift att stärka den rymdrelaterade förmågan och motståndskraften inom det civila försvaret och beredskapssystemet. Sektionen arbetar med rymdsäkerhetsrelaterade frågor nationellt och inom EU. Sektionen finns i både Karlstad och Stockholm och består av såväl mer erfarna som mer juniora medarbetare.
   

  

 Sektionen befinner sig i en stark utvecklingsfas. Utöver rymdsäkerhetsområdet utvecklas även arbetet med obemannade system, inklusive frågor kopplade till såväl nyttor som hot. Områdena har flera gemensamma beröringspunkter, inte minst inom beredskap, lägesbild, kommunikation och teknisk förmågeutveckling.
   

  

 Vi har aktivitetsbaserat kontor där du kan välja arbetsplats efter egna behov. Du kan också ha möjlighet till distansarbete i viss omfattning. Vi erbjuder dig också en möjlighet att ta ut friskvårdstimme och du får även ett friskvårdsbidrag. För dig som statligt anställd finns också förmånliga semestervillkor.
   

  

 Alla vi som arbetar på Myndigheten för civilt försvar förväntas och ska bidra till ökad jämställdhet och likabehandling för en arbetsmiljö och ett samhälle fritt från diskriminering.
   

  

 Läs mer om vår organisation, förmåner och hur det är att arbeta hos oss
   

  

**Vill du veta mer?**
 Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta sektionschef Kristoffer Hultgren. Fackliga företrädare är Carl Önne (Saco-S), Jan Herremo (ST) och Josefin Berglund eller Ann-Britt Paradis (SEKO). Samtliga nås via växelnummer 0771-240 240.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 1 november 2026**
