title: Head of Transformation & Portfolio Simplification
description:
We’re looking for a
 **Head of Transformation & Portfolio Simplification** 
 to join us at Telia.
   

  

 I’m Anna von Gegerfelt, Head of Operational Excellence & Transformation within B2B Telia Sweden, and we are searching for someone up for a challenge and ready to grow with us at Telia B2B. We’re a supportive, forward-thinking organization focused on customer experience, simplicity and sustainable growth.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
 You will be a key part of the B2B Operational Excellence & Transformation leadership team, responsible for driving best-in-class customer experience and optimizing internal operations. Our ultimate goal is to make it easy to do business with us through simplification, digitalization, and transparency.
   

  

 As our Head of Transformation & Portfolio Simplification you will lead a team of experienced project managers, customer migration specialists, change & roll-out agents and business transformation architects focused on transforming, digitalizing, automating and simplifying our portfolio and underlying technical landscape.
   

  

 You and your team will define, plan and execute on business transformation targets, leading the journey towards a simplified offering model, transformed way of working and automated, AI enabling IT landscape. You will coordinate and drive change management, communication and roll-out across the full organization and follow-up on business value realization. Your team will also lead Portfolio Simplification projects initiated by our Business Management unit, migrating offerings and customers to new technical solutions or platforms. In short: enabling streamlined, quick-to-market, easy-to-use and AI-enabled business operations.
   

  

* Develop our business and customer operations by transforming our way of working and simplifying our portfolio and IT landscape.
* Create the foundation that allows us to become streamlined, transparent, quick-to-market and AI enables, delivering on business transformation goals by designing, implementing and rolling out our next generation BSS landscape for Telia B2B.
* Consult with stakeholders throughout the organization to understand business and operational needs and requirements, translate that into target way of working, solution requirements and measurable business values.
* Cooperate with Customer Operations, Sales, Business Management, Operational Excellence as well as IT right-sizing the level of digitalization and automation taking high / low volume and wanted customer interaction into account, managing roll-out and change management to the different units.
* Balance strategic direction with tactical execution, ensuring ideas become valuable customer outcomes.


**What will help you thrive in this role:**
 To succeed in this role, you have the ability to drive simplification and question the status quo, challenging business, operations and IT to simplify and standardize offerings, ways of working and solutions. You can balance different needs and requirements, and you dare to propose action and take ownership of the total solutions. You are a strong communicator with the ability to create clarity and give direction and you lead by example, cooperating with teams and individuals throughout the organizations.
   

  

* Proven experience in leadership, project & program management, transformation / digitalization in complex B2B industries, change management and customer migrations.
* Strong knowledge of end to end customer processes, related business rules & offering modelling and overall BSS architecture, preferably from B2B telco or similar industry.
* Ability to engage, envision and execute, create clarity and deliver measurable outcomes. Structured decision maker with cross-functional cooperation skills.
* Fluency in English & Swedish.


**Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet**
 At Telia, we’re a team of 15 000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Leading Telecommunications Operator & Climate Leader, we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world.
   

  

 Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment. Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.
   

  

**Ready to make better happen?**
 We look forward to receiving your application by
 **2026-10-24** 
 . Please note that the recruitment process will start as soon as the ad is published, so please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

**The next step in the recruitment process** 
 is to complete a personality test via Alva Labs. You will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Team. We use tests to ensure an objective and fair selection that increases the accuracy of finding the right candidate for the role.
   

  

 Background checks will be part of the process.
   

  

 Have any questions? Please reach out recruiting manager Anna Von Gegerfelt at anna.von-gegerfelt@teliacompany.com
   

  

**Equal opportunities**
 At Telia, we recognize talent by
 **professional skills and growth potential.** 
 We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where
 **your uniqueness is our strength.**
**Join us and let’s make better happen - together!**

title: Specialist inom Digital projekthanterare / Datasamordnare
description:
**Job Description**
*Vill du vara med och driva digital informationshantering för Sveriges infrastruktur? Hos oss är det möjligt!*
**Vårt erbjudande**
 På avdelningen Digital Solutions stödjer vi verksamheter inom infrastruktur, transport och samhällsbyggnad med informationshantering, digital projekthantering och förvaltningsstöd. Vi söker nu specialist inom Digitala projekthantering som vill bidra till WSP digitala affär och få möjligheten att arbeta tillsammans med andra digitala projekthanterare och bidrar till samhällsviktiga projekt.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som Digital Projekthanterare arbetar du med att säkerställa att information är korrekt, tillgänglig och användbar genom hela livscykeln för infrastruktur- och anläggningsprojekt. Du arbetar nära projektledare, förvaltningsorganisationer och tekniska specialister. Rollen kombinerar operativ informationshantering med samordning och förbättringsarbete.
   

  

 Du förväntas vara lyhörd för kundens verksamhet och kunna omsätta kundbehov till konkreta lösningar där du aktivt bidra till att utveckla såväl uppdraget som samarbetet med kunden.
   

  

 I din roll ska du vara expert inom dokument- och informationshanteringssystem, metadatahantering, strukturering av digital information och kunna ge våra uppdrag rätt förutsättning för att digitalt kunna utföra sitt arbete.
   

  

 Rollen är ofta centralt placerad i våra uppdrag och du ska både kunde handleda andra projektmedlemmar, vara en mentor för juniora medarbetare och själv driva och leda mindre team av informationshanterare.
   

  

*Arbetsuppgifterna består bland annat av:*
* Leda och delta i möten gällande digital projekthantering
* Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, processer och standarder
* Strukturera och kvalitetssäkra projektinformation
* Samordna digitala krav och rutiner
* Upprätta och administrera digitala projektytor, informationshanteringssystem och dokumenthanteringssystem
* Sätta upp informationsstrukturer i uppdrag
* Säkerställa korrekt metadata och namnsättning
* Stötta uppdrag och uppdragsledare i informationshantering och systemanvändning
* Genomföra granskning av handlingar
* Kvalitetssäkring, leveranshantering och uppföljning av leveranser
* Arbeta med CAD-relaterade uppgifter
* Identifiering av utvecklingsbehov och förbättringsmöjligheter


**Placeringsort:** 
 Stockholm, Göteborg, Linköping eller Halmstad. Arbetet bedrivs huvudsakligen i nära samarbete med kunders verksamhet och innebär regelbunden fysisk närvaro.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har dokumenterad erfarenhet av digital projekthantering eller datasamordning inom infrastruktur och samhällsutveckling.
   

  

**Krav** 
 :
   

  

* Minst 6 års erfarenhet som digital projekthantering, datasamordnare eller likvärdig roll inom infrastruktur-, transport-, anläggnings- eller samhällsbyggnadssektorn. Erfarenhet ska komma från anställning hos beställare eller direkt konsultuppdrag.
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet från offentlig beställarorganisation
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete i digitalt informations- eller dokumenthanteringssystem
* Högskoleexamen eller yrkeshögskoleexamen där utbildningen ska kunna styrkas med utbildningsintyg
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


**Meriterande** 
 :
   

  

* Kunskap om standarder som ISO 19650 och ISO 55000
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom drift, underhåll eller förvaltning
* Erfarenhet av 3D CAD-modeller och BIM-processer


**Personliga egenskaper**
 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har förmåga att förstå kundens verksamhet, behov och mål samt tar initiativ och ser möjligheter att förbättra och vidareutveckla våra uppdrag.Du har förståelse för vikten av strukturerad informationshantering och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera noggrannhet med samarbete och verksamhetsstöd.Utöver det vill handleda och stötta juniora medarbetareoch trivs med att arbeta både i Team och självständigt
   

  

 Utöver det är god samarbets-, kommunikations-och problemlösningsförmåga något vi värderar högt.
   

  

**Kontakt**
 Tveka inte att höra av dig till oss om du har frågor!
   

  

 Cecilia Marklund, Manager – project quality management, cecilia.marklund@wsp.com
   

  

 Jesper Steenberg, rekryterare, jesper.steenberg@wsp.com
   

  

**Sista ansökningsdag**
 Urval sker löpande men vi vill senast få in din ansökan 2026-10-31.
   

  

 Kontakt från rekryteringsföretag, CV- och annonssäljare undanbedes.
   

  

**OM WSP I SVERIGE**
 WSP är en av världens ledande teknikkonsulter. Med en enastående bredd av ingenjörer, rådgivare och forskare förenas våra globala talanger för att utveckla lokala lösningar.
   

  

 WSP är verksamma i över 50 länder och har cirka 83 000 medarbetare, eller som vi säger Visionärer. På WSP i Sverige jobbar cirka 3 800 konsulter med att leverera innovativa projekt inom transport, infrastruktur, byggnation, miljö, projektledning, strategisk rådgivning och energi.
   

  

 Följ oss gärna på WSP Sverige (LinkedIn), WSP Sverige (Facebook), eller @wspsweden (Instagram) för en närmare inblick i vår verksamhet samt hur en dag i arbetet kan se ut för våra medarbetare.

title: Senior Account Executive - Stockholm
description:
**Build something monumental for Healthcare!**
 At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.
   

  

 We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!
   

  

**About The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Account Executive** 
 to help drive and grow our footprint across the Swedish region. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across Sweden.
   

  

 In this position, you will actively represent Tandem at trade fairs, events, and in direct conversations with physicians, doctors, and decision-makers. You contribute to our mission where it matters most - into personal contact with our future partners. Your goal is to position our solutions in the market, drive new business, and strengthen existing relationships.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Actively acquire new customers through a combination of outbound efforts (cold calling, appointment setting, product demos, negotiations, and closing) and partner-led sales in close collaboration with commercial partners, with both channels being equally important for success.
* Drive and contribute to public tender processes, ensuring high-quality submissions and strategic positioning; prior experience working with public tenders is highly desirable.
* Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with a diverse group of stakeholders, including end-users (such as social workers, medical nurses, and student health professionals), key decision-makers, and commercial partners.
* Develop a deep understanding of end-user needs and pain points, demonstrating a genuine interest in improving their day-to-day work and outcomes.
* Represent Tandem Health at trade fairs, conferences, and industry events, acting as an ambassador for our mission, solutions, and long-term vision.
* Strategically plan and execute sales initiatives to effectively penetrate and grow within the Swedish market, with a focus on building sustainable, long-term partnerships rather than short-term wins.
* Collaborate closely with SDR, marketing, product, customer success, and partner teams to incorporate market feedback and continuously improve the customer experience and offering.
* Use digital GTM tools and CRM systems to manage leads, opportunities, and partnerships in a structured, transparent way.


**What You Bring**
* Demonstrated multi-year successful sales experience, ideally gained in the SaaS, technology or healthcare sector.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to deliver compelling presentations to diverse audiences.
* Prior experience driving and / or contributing to public tender processes would be highly beneficial in this role.
* A high level of initiative, a structured approach to work, and a passion for embracing challenges in a dynamic environment.
* Native level in Swedish and fluent in English, with excellent communication skills, both written and spoken.
* Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.


**Bonus Points**
* Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.
* Background in medtech, digital health, or regulated software.
* A completed degree in business administration, healthcare management, or a comparable qualification.
* Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


**Location**
 We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a
 **full-time role based in Stockholm** 
 where you will work primarily in order to collaborate, connect, and build our culture.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.
   

  

 Our interview process consists of stages:
   

  

* Screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* First interview with Head of Commercial Excellence
* Second interview with our Country Director
* Working Day - Join us in the Stockholm office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.


**Culture at Tandem**
 At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.
   

  

 Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.
   

  

 Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.
   

  

 We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.
   

  

*Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.*

title: Product Specialist/Overlay Sales Acct Manager AEM Nordics
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 From the moment you wake up in the morning, until you go to bed at night consider the media you consume, the adverts you see, the apps you use, the websites you browse and almost all of the shopping you do online throughout the day. Chances are that every single one of those interactions or experiences was touched by an Adobe product.
   

  

 We have a fantastic opportunity for a Product Sales Specialist to join our Digital Experience teams in the Nordics, based in Stockholm!
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Run an enterprise sales territory across the Nordics, focusing on net new business for Adobe's Content, Workfront, and Semrush solutions
* Sell the value of AI agents embedded across Content, Workfront, and Semrush, while using AI tools in your own workflow to research accounts, personalize outreach, and sharpen forecasts
* Develop target named account strategies and tactical penetration plans
* Develop and maintain relationships at the “C” and “VP” levels of the defined target named accounts
* Develop compelling value propositions based on return on investment cost/benefit analysis
* Complete the major steps of the sales process including finding new business opportunities, qualifying new opportunities, and closing new business
* Sell against annual revenue targets for software licenses and services
* Coordinate with wider Account team, including Account Executive, Solution Consultants, Partners, Professional Services, and other teams
* Contribute creative ideas and participate in marketing events
* Provide accurate and timely sales forecasts
* Develop, maintain and strengthen third-party relationships


 What You Will Need to Succeed
   

  

* 8 to 10 years' experience and success in selling high value, long lead time enterprise software solutions ($500K and above), specifically in Content Management (CMS/DAM), Marketing Work Management, or SEO and content marketing / brand visibility platforms. Tier 1 and Tier 2 customers appreciated.
* Genuine interest in how AI agents are reshaping content, work management, and marketing visibility, with practical use of AI tools in your own selling process
* Understanding of marketing and content operations dynamics, omnichannel content supply chain challenges, related cost drivers, and customer needs
* Understanding of the digital marketing, content, and work management landscape (challenges, competition) within the Nordic market
* Experience with insight selling methodology
* Ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively to bring in the right resources to bear at the right stage in the selling process
* Excellent new business development skills and sales quota attainment track record
* Mentality of a creative self-starter; shows initiative and resourcefulness to find a way into the prospect; in charge of their destiny with minimal support until the prospect is qualified
* Strong skills in the following: communication, presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills, and attention to detail
* Proficient networker. Ability to develop and use relationships with senior industry leaders and key influencers
* High comfort level and presence with senior Marketing and CX executives


 As our many awards will tell you, at Adobe you’ll be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized around the world. You’ll be surrounded by colleagues who are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where ongoing feedback flows freely. If you’re looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog, https://blog.adobe.com/en/topics/adobe-life and explore the fantastic benefits we offer at Rewards.adobe.com.
   

  

 Adobe is an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race or colour, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful. This is what it means to be Adobe For All.
   

  

 We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
   

  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
 Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
   

  

 At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

title: Produktägare inom AVK och DMD till Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset
description:
Vill du arbeta med utveckling och förvaltning av regionala tjänster inom videokonferens och digital mediadistribution? Vi söker en erfaren produktägare som vill kombinera teknisk kompetens med verksamhetsnära utveckling och bidra till välfungerande och framtidssäkra tjänster för Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset och Region Stockholm.
   

  

**Du erbjuds**
* ett delaktigt och närvarande ledarskap med goda förutsättningar för fortsatt professionell utveckling
* ett kompetent team med god sammanhållning där vi stöttar och lär av varandra
* ett nära samarbete med olika yrkesgrupper och verksamheter inom Karolinska och Region Stockholm
* en roll där du får möjlighet att påverka och utveckla regionala tjänster inom AVK och DMD.


 Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Som produktägare för videokonferens (AVK) och digital mediadistribution (DMD) ansvarar du för att leda och koordinera utveckling och förvaltning av tjänsterna med fokus på att maximera värdet av leveranserna. Du driver det operativa arbetet, samverkar med andra produktägare och säkerställer att utveckling och förvaltning sker i linje med tekniska möjligheter, verksamhetens behov och strategisk riktning.
   

  

 AVK och DMD är regionala tjänster. Rollen omfattar därför bland annat styrning, paketering, uppföljning och fakturering av tjänsternas centrala infrastruktur till anslutna bolag, stiftelser och förvaltningar inom Region Stockholm. Videokonferensområdet omfattar såväl kontorsmiljöer som exempelvis operationssalar och utbildningsmiljöer.
   

  

 Du arbetar verksamhetsnära med att fånga behov, identifiera förbättringsområden och driva kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete. I rollen ingår även kapacitetsplanering och livscykelhantering samt styrning, kvalitetsuppföljning och framtagning av kostnadsprognoser. Du identifierar också möjligheter till integration med andra tjänster som kan bidra till en bättre verksamhet inom Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset och Region Stockholm.
   

  

 En viktig del av rollen är att hålla dig uppdaterad om utvecklingen inom tjänsteområdena och bidra i Region Stockholms upphandlingsarbete. Rollen är operativ och innebär att du arbetar nära verksamheten och stöttar vid implementering och utveckling av nya tjänster och processer.
   

  

**I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att Arbeta Med**
* upphandling och avrop från centrala avtal
* livscykelhantering av befintlig infrastruktur
* leverantörsstyrning
* användarforum
* ekonomisk uppföljning, prognoser och fakturor
* produktutveckling.


 Rollen tillhör organisatoriskt enheten IT-arbetsplats och support och du rapporterar till enhetschefen.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som**
* är självgående, tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och driver arbetet framåt
* är strukturerad och planerar, organiserar och prioriterar arbetet på ett effektivt sätt
* har god samarbetsförmåga och samverkar väl med verksamheter, kollegor, kunder och leverantörer
* har god problemlösande analysförmåga och kan analysera komplexa tekniska och verksamhetsnära frågor för att hitta fungerande lösningar
* har god pedagogisk insikt och kan förklara tekniskt komplexa frågor på ett tydligt och begripligt sätt utifrån mottagarens behov.


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet för rollen.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* minst tre års erfarenhet från liknande tjänst
* teknisk bakgrund och god kännedom om större IT-miljöer och deras infrastruktur
* dokumenterad erfarenhet av tjänsteägarskap inom videokonferenssystem eller motsvarande
* mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* erfarenhet av arbete inom sjukvård och/eller myndighet
* erfarenhet av att leda projekt eller självständiga team
* erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling
* erfarenhet av projektledning
* dokumenterad erfarenhet av ITIL
* erfarenhet av att ha arbetat hos en tjänsteleverantör med ansvar för att bygga tjänster.


**Om rekryteringsprocessen**
 Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.
   

  

 I samband med din ansökan behöver du bifoga CV. Istället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig besvara urvalsfrågor samt kort motivera varför du passar för rollen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - Tillsammans är vi Karolinska!
   

  

 Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska.
   

  

 Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här.
   

  

 Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning.
   

  

 För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas.
   

  

**Om Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset**
 Vi på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är stolta över att vi är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Förutom vårt särskilda ansvar för den högspecialiserade vården i Stockholmsregionen är huvuduppdraget att tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utbilda framtidens vårdanställda och bedriva världsledande forskning samtidigt som vi fortsätter vårt arbete med att utveckla vården för patientens bästa. Vi arbetar inom en rad olika områden och professioner.
   

  

 Du kan läsa mer om vårt uppdrag inom vård, forskning och utbildning här.
   

  

 Vår vision - Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss på karolinska.se och följ oss på sociala medier!
   

  

**Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm**
 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  

 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  

 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.
   

  

 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss i Region Stockholm (öppnas i nytt fönster)
   

  

 Fackliga representanter
   

  

 Namn
   

  

 SACO Karolinska
   

  

 E-post
   

  

 saco.karolinska.karolinska@regionstockholm.se
   

  

 Namn
   

  

 Vision Karolinska
   

  

 E-post
   

  

 vision.karolinska@regionstockholm.se

title: Resiliens Konsult
description:
**Job Description**
**Resiliens Konsult**
 Vill du göra samhället mer motståndskraftigt?
   

  

 Är du vass på beredskap så som kontinuitetsförberedelser, krisledning, riskhantering, försörjningstrygghet, totalförsvar, cybersäkerhet eller säkerhetsskydd? Kan du lära oss något som vi inte förstår? Vi söker en erfaren kollega till vår resiliensavdelning som finns på flera ställen i landet.
   

  

 Vill du skapa effekt på riktigt? Vill du bli lyssnad på? Vara del i team som kan sånt som du inte hade en aning om? Lösa problem åt människor? Förstår systemperspektiv och gillar att analysera samhällsviktig verksamhet?
   

  

 Tag del av vår annons nedan och hör av dig! Vi vill bli ännu fler! Vänta inte!
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att använda din nyfikenhet och kunskap inom beredskap, totalförsvar, informationssäkerhet eller säkerhetsskydd, för att stötta Rambolls kunder att skapa ett hållbart och resilient samhälle för alla dess invånare. För att trivas och lyckas i den här rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av utredning/analysarbete, workshops, utbildning och övning inom beredskapsområdet. På Ramboll kommer du kunna omsätta dina kunskaper för att göra skillnad i framtidens Sverige och bidra till att skapa motståndskraftiga samhällen även utanför Sverige då vi även stödjer i Norden och Tyskland för den som har det intresset. Vi ser gärna att du har en bakgrund som på något sätt spetsar dina kunskaper inom resiliens och kompletterar oss andra och att du vill arbeta i en global kontext.
   

  

 Detta är en bred annons där vi snarare vill att du beskriver vad du skulle vilja och kunna göra hos oss, det finns inte en specifik tjänst färdig, vi vill snarare skapa den utifrån dina förmågor, din vilja och vad som behövs för att göra vårt samhälle mer motståndskraftigt.
   

  

 Om du är vår nya kollega inom resiliens – sök gärna!
   

  

**Du kommer att tillhöra Resiliensavdelningen**
 Som medarbetare på Resiliens kommer du bli en del av vår starka satsning för ett mer motståndskraftigt samhälle. Vi ser att Rambolls kunder har en större efterfrågan inom resiliens och vi vill att du är med och utvecklar vårt erbjudande inom det. Vi arbetar innovativt för att hitta framtidens lösningar, vi fokuserar på konkreta och effektiva metoder för en hållbar framtid. Vi arbetar ofta i team och ger dig goda möjligheter att ingå i många olika typer av uppdrag, från tidiga skeden till slutskede. I samarbete med Rambolls experter inom andra områden – exempelvis hållbarhet, beteendeförändring, organisationsutveckling eller den tekniska ingenjörssidan – löser vi även uppdrag inom bland annat vattenrening, infrastruktur, sjukhus, energi och fastighet. Genom att arbeta tillsammans i hela Ramboll strävar vi även efter att integrera resiliensperspektivet i den större samhällsbyggnadskontexten för att skapa verkligt motståndskraftiga samhällen.
   

  

  

  

 Ramboll Resiliens verkar över hela Sverige.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**
* Genomföra utbildningar och övningar inom exempelvis krisberedskap, totalförsvar, säkerhetsskydd eller angränsande delar
* Utreda och analysera komplexa utmaningar och möjligheter
* Metodutveckling inom krisberedskap, totalförsvar säkerhetsskydd eller angränsande delar
* Strategisk rådgivning inom resiliens


**Utvecklas tillsammans med oss**
 På Ramboll lägger vi stor vikt vid att möjliggöra din personliga och professionella utveckling. Vi erbjuder en dynamisk, inspirerande och innovativ konsultmiljö, där du får arbeta med ambitiösa kunder och kollegor. Dina kollegor utmärks alla av sitt stora samhällsengagemang, sin höga prestationsnivå, utvecklingsvilja, kompetens och prestigelöshet. Gemensamt för alla våra uppdrag är viljan att driva hållbar omställning tillsammans med våra uppdragsgivare och i samhället i stort.
   

  

 För att du ska växa och utvecklas finns här ett nära ledarskap som utmanar, coachar och inkluderar dig i strategiska beslut, där du som medarbetare har ett stort inflytande över vilka frågor och uppdrag du fokuserar på.
   

  

 Vi fäster större vikt vid dina individuella egenskaper och drivkrafter än formella meriter. Men för att lyckas i den här rollen tror vi att:
   

  

  

* Du är villig att utvecklas i din roll och vågar tänka nytt för att utforska nya lösningar
* Du har en vilja och förmåga att skapa delar i ett holistiskt system av andra mekanismer samtidigt som du är konkret.
* Du har erfarenhet av att vägleda och stödja verksamheter
* Du har erfarenhet av planering och utförande av workshops och/eller utbildningar, både digitala och fysiska utbildningar
* Du har goda kommunikativa förmågor i både tal och skrift, på både svenska och engelska
* Du har ett driv att utvecklas inom området och trivs med att ta ett stort eget ansvar
* Erfarenhet och förmåga inom annat område inom resiliens är meriterande då vi ofta verkar i kombinerade uppdrag.
* Du är väl förtrogen med lagstiftning och styrning inom krisberedskap och totalförsvar och förstår hur dessa hänger ihop
* Om du har erfarenhet av kriskommunikation eller angränsande områden är det meriterande


 Om du dessutom gillar att skriva, skapa strukturer i en omgivning som snabbt förändras, är flexibel och kanske varit konsult tidigare så är vi övertygade om att du är rätt för oss, kanske är vi rätt för dig?
   

  

 Du är en person som är ansvarstagande och självständig i dina arbetsuppgifter. Tack vare din strategiska infallsvinkel och samarbetsförmåga lyckas du möta våra kunders krav och leverera lösningar anpassade till morgondagens samhälle. Du är lösningsorienterad och trivs när du arbetar i intressanta projekt där din förmåga att tänka långsiktigt utmanas.
   

  

 Har du erfarenhet från att vara konsult så är du särskilt intressant.
   

  

**Välkommen till Ramboll Management Consulting och Ramboll**
 Ramboll Management Consulting är ett ledande konsultbolag i Norden inom hållbar omställning. Vi är experter på uppdrag där våra kunder styrs eller påverkas av politiska beslut och är specialister på att arbeta interdisciplinärt över gränser. Med 700 konsulter globalt, varav 110 i Sverige, får du hos oss en chans att utvecklas nationellt och globalt inom en stor variation av verksamhetsområden, marknadssegment och uppdragstyper, såväl inom privat som offentlig sektor.
   

  

 Ramboll Management Consulting är en del av Ramboll – en ledande samhällsutvecklare med 17 000 experter i 35 länder som designar framtidens samhällen där människor och natur kan blomstra. I Sverige är vi mer än 1 800 experter på ett trettiotal kontor. Vår globala strategi – ”The Partner for Sustainable Change” – pekar ut en tydlig ambition om Ramboll som en global ledare inom fyra hållbarhetsområden: ”Decarbonize for net zero”, ”Resilient societies and liveability”, ”Resource management and circular economy” och ”Biodiversity and ecosystems”. Med våra grundares värderingar i ryggen, och Rambollfonden som ägare, är Ramboll ”All in” på hållbarhet.
   

  

**Mångfald och en bredd av perspektiv är viktigt för oss**
 För oss är det viktigt att all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden tas tillvara. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och eftersträvar en mångfald av perspektiv och erfarenheter. Därför ser vi gärna sökande till den här tjänsten som inte är som vi.
   

  

**Din ansökan**
 Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Bifoga ditt CV och personliga brev som beskriver varför du är rätt person för det här jobbet. Arbetsspråk är svenska.  Vi ser fram emot din ansökan så snart som möjligt, vi kommer att hantera ansökningar löpande i denna rekrytering, vänta därför inte med att söka.
   

  

 Att jobba som konsult vid Ramboll Resiliens innebär att du kan komma att omfattas av säkerhetsprövning.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Engagement Associate
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 You'll support the post-sale customer experience, contributing to onboarding, adoption and long-term value realization across Legora's strategic and enterprise accounts. Specifically, you will:
   

  

* Contribute to each client's adoption playbook: supporting the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how that firm adopts Legora and transforms the way they work.
* Help execute against that playbook, owning discrete workstreams from initial rollout to firm-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.
* Build product fluency and a feel for client goals and legal workflows, surfacing opportunities to the leads you support and helping guide client teams toward value from Legora.
* Support a structured operating cadence: preparing success plans and training resources, running enablement sessions, and helping with stakeholder check-ins and value reviews.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), helping maintain end-to-end account context and coordination.
* Support the team on key commercial moments to help ensure seamless handoffs, continuity, and a great customer experience, and to flag expansion signals to the account lead.
* Channel customer feedback to Product, Engineering, and Marketing to help inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement.
* Track account health and usage in our tools, surfacing early signals of risk or opportunity to the leads you support.
* Learn the craft fast — observing how senior Engagement Managers operate, seeking feedback, and applying it as you grow toward owning accounts of your own.


**What You Bring**
 You care deeply about customer outcomes and you're eager to learn how transformation is designed and led. You're proactive, organized and energized by supporting demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in helping customers adopt, grow and succeed.
   

  

* A foundation in management consulting, client advisory, a customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, or the legal field, ideally with exposure to large, complex organizations.
* Experience supporting client-level projects and helping drive them toward measurable outcomes.
* 1+ years in management consulting, customer success, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B SaaS or Legal Tech.
* Exposure to supporting adoption, retention, and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
* Experience working with legal, compliance, or other regulated and complex industries or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast.
* Strong organizational and project management instincts; you juggle multiple workstreams without dropping detail.
* Clear, confident communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal. You're comfortable running client calls and supporting senior and hands-on stakeholders alike.
* High EQ: you know when to listen, when to ask and when to act.
* A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you are eager to learn the playbook and contribute to building it.
* Comfort with metrics and driven by data, customer health, and outcomes over process.
* An appetite for AI — eager to automate your own work and pick up the tools the team uses to create leverage.
* Curiosity and a growth mindset — you learn complex products and industries fast and want to grow toward owning accounts of your own.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Field Sales Service Technician
description:
**We are now looking for a** ***Field Sales Service Technician in Sollentuna*****.**

  

At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 110,000 employees.


Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

 **Our values guide how we work:**

* We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
* We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
* We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation

  

Global Commercial, a function within Care Enablement, unites Sales, Marketing, Global Sales Excellence, and Global Technical Operations. This team delivers high-quality medical devices, technical services, and effective commercial strategies across global markets, advancing our mission to improve patient lives. Join our passionate team and help shape healthcare worldwide!

  

As a Field Sales Service Technician (*in Sollentuna* Sweden), is responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing dialysis machines and water treatment systems. The role combines field service activities at hospitals and healthcare facilities with project coordination and administrative tasks. The ideal candidate has a technical background in medical technology, electronics, or engineering, is customer-oriented, able to work independently, and willing to travel regularly. The position offers extensive training, a high level of responsibility, and the opportunity to contribute to life-saving healthcare solutions within an international environment.

  

Your Responsibilities:

  

As a service technician, you are part of a team of seven employees who work with similar tasks but with a slightly different focus and there are good opportunities to continue learning new areas of technology. In the Nordics, you share your experience and knowledge with other collogues and occasionally meet them.

  

As a service technician/engineer, you have a flexible role with varied tasks. It is important that the rules, procedures and regulations setup for the repair of the machines are followed to the letter.

  

Your main tasks will include

* Servicing of medical equipment at customer´s side
* Support the hospital's technicians by phone
* Preventive maintenance of dialysis machines
* Repair of minor equipment sent to the office
* Installing new dialysis machines and equipment
* Document and report your activities in a technical reporting system

  

Your Profile:

  

We are looking for you with education in medical technology, electronics or other relevant education, preferable medical background. We see that you are a driven person with a desire to learn as motivation is important for the role. Your home location can be Stockholm region or surroundings.


Professional experience:

  

* Education in the above-mentioned field
* Experience in working in hospital environment would be considered as an advantage
* Service-minded and customer focused attitude

  

IT skills:

* Understand and use modern communication software and systems
* Strong IT user knowledge (MS Office 365)
* Understand basics of e-health, data security and related topics
* Up-to-date knowledge of IT and digitalization

  

Language skills:

* You are fluent in both spoken and written Swedish
* Proficient in English, as Fresenius Medical Care is German-owned and training and other major meetings are held in English, and it is important that you are comfortable with the English language in speech and writing.

  

Personal competencies:

* Strong customer orientation and ability to represent FME towards the customers
* Strong professional attitude characterized by a result, quality, patient, and customer-oriented working style
* Strong structured approach leading to pragmatic and effective solutions
* Strong ability to set priorities and take decisions even under changing conditions
* Strong ability to work as a self-starter and self-responsible
* Strong Communications skills
* High level of flexibility, openness, and empathy well balanced with high resilience, persuasiveness, self-confidence and good ability to work in a structured way even under pressure.

  

For more information contact: Niklas Blomberg: +46 7370 77638

  

Our Offer For You:


 There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.

  

* Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
* Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
* A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
* A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
* The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

  

Fresenius Medical Care is a market leader in its niche and at the forefront of innovative solutions for dialysis machine development. You will join a financially stable company whose machines are life-saving for their patients.


You will join a harmonious and cohesive group where everyone is there for each other and helps each other to achieve mutual success. You will be provided by although training together with colleagues who have also worked in the company for a long time. Every Monday starts with a service meeting where the team jointly reviews what has happened in the previous week and what is happening in the coming week. Although the company is large and the industry is regulated, the Swedish part is smaller and there are good opportunities to make your voice heard.

  

You will have a role with a lot of responsibility where you will have the opportunity to organised your days and weeks independently. You will be travelling maximum 50 nights a year in connection with the installation, repairs and service issues that cannot be done over the phone. On the nights you sometimes sleep elsewhere, you will receive an extra allowance in addition to the tax-free part.

  

The working hours for the position are 35 hours/week and you have a relatively high degree of flexibility to plan your travelling around the country. You will be offered a good basic salary with a bonus component and an attractive benefits package that includes:

  

* company car
* additional supplement to the mileage allowance
* health care allowance
* occupational pension
* extra holiday days
* health examination
* occupational health care
* paid mobile phone

 **Is this you? Apply today!**

title: Frontend Team Lead – Simulation Software
description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to develop web-based functionality for COMSOL Multiphysics® and related products. In this hands-on role, you will combine software development in TypeScript and Vue with technical leadership, team management, and coordination of the team’s development projects, working on software used by engineers and researchers around the world.


**About COMSOL**
----------------


COMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.


**Role**
--------


Based in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.


Your main focus will be web frontend development for functionality that extends how our customers work with simulation software. This includes tools for managing simulation models and data, running and interacting with simulations, and making simulation functionality available to different users and computing environments. One example is the Model Manager, our process and data management system for simulation modeling. Other projects cover areas such as simulation apps, computational workflows, and functionality for deploying and using simulation models in new contexts.


The projects evolve together with the COMSOL product suite, and you will have the opportunity to work on both established functionality and new product areas. The common challenge is to create intuitive web interfaces for sophisticated engineering software, often bringing together frontend development with complex underlying functionality and large amounts of technical data.


As team lead, you will remain closely involved in software development while also managing the team and its projects. You will write and review code, contribute to product and technical design, make technical decisions, plan development projects, and guide and support the developers in the team. You will be responsible for creating an environment where the team can deliver high-quality software and grow professionally.


Our web frontends are part of engineering software products rather than continuously deployed web services. The functionality you develop is released as part of software that our customers install and operate in their own environments. This brings challenges in areas such as compatibility, upgrades, performance, security, and long-term maintainability, and calls for careful design of functionality that will remain part of the products for years.


**Qualifications**
------------------


For this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer who combines strong technical skills with the ability to manage a development team and its projects. We are looking for the following qualifications:


* M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related field.
* Excellent programming skills and several years of professional software development experience.
* Experience developing substantial web frontends using TypeScript or JavaScript and a modern frontend framework.
* Experience taking technical responsibility for software projects or significant areas of a product.
* Good communication and organizational skills, with the ability to set priorities, make decisions, and support other developers in their work.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:


* Vue, React, or similar component-based frontend frameworks.
* Managing or coordinating a software development team.
* Project management within software development.
* Mentoring developers and providing constructive technical feedback.
* Planning larger development projects and coordinating work between developers.
* Designing and evolving user interfaces for complex applications.
* Large software projects and mature codebases.
* Software that is installed and operated in customer environments.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.


**Working at COMSOL**
---------------------


At COMSOL, frontend development is closely connected to the products as a whole. You will work on functionality that makes sophisticated simulation capabilities accessible in new ways, as part of an organization where many different areas of expertise contribute to the same product family.


New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape both the software and the development of your team, while remaining closely involved in hands-on software development.


We also offer:


* A competitive salary
* Individual pension plans
* Sponsored gym membership
* Work-life balance with regular working hours

This role is primarily based in our Stockholm office, where in-person collaboration is an important part of working with and supporting the team. We also offer flexibility to work from home when compatible with the needs of the team and the role.


**To Apply**
------------


Does this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish Make sure to include:


* Cover letter
* CV
* University diploma with grades

Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.


To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.


For more information, contact us at tel. 08-412 95 00.


We review applications continuously.

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
Curamando, part of the Nordic consulting house Eidra, specialises in accelerating top-line growth through digital strategy and innovation. We're a fast-growing consultancy already partnering with industry leaders - from cutting-edge automotive brands to forward-looking tech companies. Together with Eidra's 1,200+ strategists, creatives, and engineers across Stockholm, New York, and beyond, we tackle ambitious problems at scale.


Our AI practice is growing fast, and we are now looking for the person who will be the architect behind our next generation of AI builds.

**Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for a hands-on AI Solutions Architect with a proven track record of designing and delivering AI solutions that make it into production. You have been the architect behind several AI projects already, and you can walk into a client situation and say - with the calm of someone who has done it many times - how this should be built: what the solution looks like, what team it needs, how long it will take, and in what stages it should be rolled out.


This is a senior, technical, client-facing role. It is not a people-leadership role, and it is not a project-management role. You will shape the scope and the architecture of the whole project, and then roll up your sleeves and be part of building it.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Architect the build.** Design AI solutions that fit the client's problem, data and organisation - increasingly agentic systems with context, memory and tool handling on top of a solid data foundation. Understand the trade-offs, communicate them clearly, and help the team choose the right technology.
* **Scope and size projects.** Turn a client's ambition into a concrete plan: the solution architecture, the team composition, the timeline, the phases and rollout stages, what is in and out of scope, and how to phase and price it. This is the core of the role.
* **Be part of building.** Not just the diagram - the build. Go into projects, work alongside our AI engineers, review the critical pieces, unblock the team, and make sure the architecture survives contact with reality.
* **Be the client's technical counterpart.** Establish trust as a recognised AI authority, guide clients through the possibilities, limitations, suitability and risks of AI solutions, and enjoy talking about the value you create. You will contribute to proposals and pitches alongside our commercial leads.
* **Own the journey to production.** Break complex challenges into manageable parts, prioritise the key deliverables, identify and resolve bottlenecks, catch the overlooked details, and anticipate what could go wrong before it does.
* **Design for Operate and Transfer.** Build with operability and hand-over in mind from day one, and stay engaged as the solution moves from build into operation and, eventually, into the client's own hands.
* **Stay ahead of the curve.** Follow the development of the AI stack and the regulatory landscape across the markets we work in, and bring that knowledge into architectural decisions.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **You have a solid technical background**, most likely from the software or tech sector - a product company, a scale-up, or a technology consultancy - and you have been the architect behind several AI projects that reached production.
* **You've done the hands-on work.** Whatever your current title - engineer, architect, tech lead, technical product manager - you have built things hands-on at some point in your career, and you can still go deep when it matters.
* **You can size a project.** Given a problem, you can quickly and credibly say what team is needed, how long it will take and how it should be staged - because you have done it many times before.
* **You have a strong intuition for AI**, and you know how to balance its transformative potential against its practical limitations.
* **You are familiar in the modern AI stack**: You understand the purpose and place where LLM-based and agentic architectures fit (frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, Mastra or Microsoft Agent Framework), evaluation and observability tooling (Langfuse, Promptfoo or similar), data pipelines and MLOps - and you know the classical ML side (PyTorch/TensorFlow, fine-tuning, PEFT) well enough to know when it is the right tool.
* **You are commercially minded and enjoy talking to clients** - about their problem, and about the value you bring. You do not need to be a people leader, but this is not a role for someone who would rather sit behind a closed door with a computer.
* **Consultancy experience is a plus**, not a must.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Mynt**


Mynt is an all-in-one corporate card and spend management platform on a mission to reinvent business banking. By combining smart software with cards and payments infrastructure, we remove manual, time-consuming admin from how companies manage spending.


We're growing fast across the Nordics and have secured significant funding to support our continued expansion in Sweden and internationally.


Mynt is a tech-first, product-driven company where teams are empowered to solve real problems and build things that matter. We're a licensed e-money institution, card issuer, and payment processor, operating under the supervision of the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority. Through strong partnerships with leading players such as Fortnox and Nordea — and many more on the way — our solutions are now live across all Nordic countries.


Joining Mynt means helping shape both a category-defining product and a company that's still early in its journey. With 100+ colleagues (and growing), we're building teams that value ownership, momentum, and customer impact.

**About the role**


We are looking for a **Solutions Engineer** to be the bridge between our sales team and our product and tech teams. You will join customer meetings to explain how Mynt works, answer the hard product questions and design the right setup for each customer. Inside Mynt, you are the person sales turns to whenever a question is about the product, integrations or what is technically possible.

**What you'll do**

* Be the technical voice in sales meetings: run demos, dig into the details and turn objections into "oh, that's neat"
* Map each customer's needs and processes and design how Mynt fits in across accounting systems, ERPs and card setups
* Support larger deals with solution design, technical documentation and answers to RFPs and security questionnaires
* Keep the sales team sharp by owning product training, building enablement material like FAQs and demo environments, and making sure every new release lands with clear positioning
* Bring customer insights and recurring blockers back to product and tech, and help prioritise what matters most for winning deals
* Make handovers to onboarding and customer success smooth for technically complex customers

**Who you are**

* 3+ years as a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager or in a similar customer-facing technical role, preferably in B2B SaaS or fintech
* Comfortable with technical concepts such as APIs, integrations and data flows, and able to explain them in simple terms to non-technical people
* Confident in customer meetings, from finance teams to CFOs and IT managers
* You're genuinely curious about how businesses run, and structured in how you solve problems
* You build trust easily with customers, sellers and engineers alike
* You're fluent in Swedish and English

**Bonus points**

* Experience with accounting, bookkeeping, VAT or reconciliation, or with systems such as Fortnox, Visma or Business Central
* Knowledge of card payments, expense management or the Nordic fintech market
* An engineering, computer science or business degree

**What we offer**

* A key role at the centre of sales and product in a fast-growing fintech
* A flexible working environment with an office in central Stockholm
* 30 vacation days per year
* 5000 SEK Wellness allowance
* Competitive salary
* Recurring team activities and social events

*We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please don't wait to apply.*

title: Senior Android Engineer - Stockholm
description:
**About Justera Group**  

Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.  

  

**About the Role:**  

We are looking for a Senior Android Engineer to join a mature mobile application that is currently undergoing a significant modernization.


The Android application is built with Kotlin and is transitioning from traditional XML-based UI development to Jetpack Compose. The team is also adopting Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) as part of its long-term mobile architecture, enabling shared business logic across Android and iOS while maintaining native user interfaces on both platforms.


You will take ownership of the Android application, ensuring continued stability and quality while helping drive the modernization forward.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Take ownership of the Android application following a structured handover.
* Own Android releases, application stability, performance, and overall quality.
* Continue the migration from XML-based UI to Jetpack Compose.
* Integrate and manage native components within Compose-based UI and lifecycle.
* Contribute to the shared Kotlin Multiplatform layer in collaboration with the iOS team.
* Investigate and resolve technical issues, bugs, and performance challenges.
* Document key technical areas, architecture, and processes.
* Support a smooth knowledge transfer to a permanent team member at the end of the assignment.

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of professional Android development experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kotlin.
* Excellent knowledge of Jetpack Compose and modern Android development practices.
* Strong understanding of modern Android architecture and application lifecycle.
* Proven experience maintaining and developing production applications with a significant user base.
* Solid understanding of Android stability, performance, debugging, and release processes.
* Professional experience with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of a mature codebase.
* Strong communication skills in English.

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies
* The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package
* A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development
* Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance
* 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax
* An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Instrument and Controls Commissioning Lead Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:** The Lead Instrument and Controls Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for overseeing the commissioning, start-up, and optimization of all instrumentation and control systems in the Stegra Hydrogen to Green Steel Project. Reporting directly to the Overall CSU Manager, this role requires extensive experience with major control systems, interfacing with various package types, protocols such as Modbus and Profibus, and advanced troubleshooting and tuning capabilities. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the plant's instrumentation and control systems are fully operational, tuned, and optimized to support green steel production. Key Responsibilities: Commissioning Leadership: Lead all commissioning activities related to instrumentation and controls, ensuring compliance with project specifications and quality standards.

Additionally, the Preservation Engineer may provide input on preservation ordinances and participate in the planning, programming, and budgeting of preservation projects. The Preservation Lead collaborates with multiple teams, including construction, commissioning, maintenance, and operations, to ensure that all preservation activities are carried out effectively.
  
  

This position requires a strong technical background, an understanding of preservation techniques, and the ability to manage preservation-related documentation. Key Responsibilities: Preservation System Management: Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive preservation system to ensure the integrity and protection of plant and equipment. Develop & implement comprehensive preservation procedures including information from the OEM's and Technology providers to ensure the integrity and protection of the equipment. Ensure that preservation procedures are followed during construction, storage, transportation, and operational phases.
  
  

Monitor and update preservation activities throughout the lifecycle of equipment and plant assets to prevent deterioration, corrosion, or damage. Approve preservation methods, materials, and protocols to maintain the safety and operability of equipment. Develop and maintain comprehensive preservation documentation, including preservation manuals and checklists. Coordinate with procurement and logistics teams to ensure that preserved equipment is properly stored and handled during transportation and delivery. title: Senior Mobile AI Engineer
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.


We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a **Senior Mobile AI Engineer** in our **Stockholm** office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?


### **The Role**


You’ll join a small, multidisciplinary team building products that create value for our users and business. Working closely with product, design and engineering colleagues, you’ll turn agreed opportunities into useful mobile experiences and validate them with users.


AI will be a core part of how you build and deliver, from development through testing and validation. You’ll help improve these ways of working and share what works with the wider organisation.


You’ll bring depth in at least one native mobile platform, iOS or Android, and contribute hands-on beyond it, whether through another mobile platform, frontend or backend development. Together, you’ll take responsibility for the products you deliver and how they perform after release.


The team starts with a lab approach: focused scope, short feedback loops and room to experiment. As we learn what works, the aim is to evolve into an established structure with ongoing product responsibilities. You’ll help shape that journey and take care of the products as they develop.


**What your day might look like:**


* Turn agreed product scope into working products and testable releases
* Build and maintain mobile experiences and contribute across platforms and technologies as needed
* Work with product and design to use data, user insights, and hypotheses to guide implementation and validate outcomes
* Apply and improve advanced AI-native workflows across development, testing, and validation
* Integrate AI capabilities where they add value to the product
* Improve accessibility, performance, reliability, and maintainability as products develop
* Contribute to deployment, maintenance and operation, taking responsibility for the software you deliver
* Share knowledge, review work with colleagues, and help the team develop its practices

### **What we’re looking for**


You’ve used AI across substantial parts of product delivery, beyond individual coding suggestions. You can explain your contribution, how you verified the result, and what you learned.


**For this role, we’re looking for:**


* **Technical depth:** Strong native mobile engineering in Swift for iOS or Kotlin for Android, including production delivery and maintenance, APIs, automated testing, debugging and release processes
* **Practical width:** Hands-on capability in at least one additional area, whether a second mobile platform, frontend or backend development
* **AI-native delivery:** Experience using advanced workflows, such as agent-based or spec-driven development. You can structure work for AI, provide context, evaluate the resulting software and take responsibility for what reaches production
* **Product experience:** Worked in a product organisation and a cross-functional product team with product managers and designers. You use data and user insights to test hypotheses, validate value and take shared responsibility for outcomes after release.

**It’s a bonus if you have:**


* Experience developing for both iOS and Android
* Strong frontend or backend engineering skills that broaden your contribution
* Experience with accessibility, mobile performance or media, and streaming products

You bring approaches we can learn from and can demonstrate where AI has improved your delivery, as well as where it has required more care. You are comfortable challenging existing practices and helping the team test better ones.


We value curiosity, ownership and colleagues who are generous with their knowledge and help others succeed.


### **What's in it for you**


An opportunity to help shape how Viaplay builds products with AI. You’ll work closely with colleagues across disciplines, contribute beyond a single platform and see how your work influences both the products we deliver and the way the team develops.


You’ll join at a stage where there is room to experiment and help establish practices that can benefit the wider organisation.


### **What we offer you**


* **We’ve got you covered!** 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* **Your wellbeing matters.** We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* **Flexibility that works.** We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* **A safe space to grow and up-skill.** Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* **An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year.** This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* **Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do.** So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

### **Hit play today**


If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
  

  

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.
